tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /yang zlog me'i spu gri'i dbang chog bdud dpung zil gnon zhes bya ba bzhugs so//'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed yang zlog me'i spu gri'i dbang chog bdud dpung zil gnon zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed po la phyag 'tshal lo// 'dir dbang thob cing dam tshig dang sdom pa la gnas pa gzhi bsnyen sngon du song ba'i slob dpon mtshan nyid dang ldan pa ni/ zla gsang rtsa rgyud kyi le'u drug pa las/ shes rab yangs pas chos rnams bstan// lta ba yangs pas phyogs dang bral// spyod pa ma 'gag thabs su sbyor// sgom pa sran che 'gyur ba med// dam tshig gang yang ma nyams pa// de ni dbang nod slob dpon no// zhes gsungs so// slob ma'i mtshan nyid/ rgyud snga ma de nyid las/ rang bzhin bzang ba nam mkha' 'dra// spyod pa bzang ba sa gzhi 'dra// dam tshig 'jigs pas mkha' ltar srung*/ */lta ba bcos pa med pa 'chang*// sku gsung thugs kyi sras byed pa// ser sna med pa'i yon gyis bslu// 'khu ldog med pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ /de la dbang rnams rdzogs par bskur| |zhes sogs gsungs so// de lta bu dang ldan pas gsol ba btab pa'i tshe dbang bskur ba la spyi don gsum/ rgyas pa dang*/ 'bring dang*/ bsdus pa'i lugs so// dang po la gsum/ sngon du 'gro ba| dngos gzhi/ rjes so// dang po ni/ slob mas gsol ba btab pa'i tshe yi dam kyi lha la dris pas/ dngos nyams rmi lam gang rung du gnang ba thob pa'am/ ma bkag pa'i mtshan ma mthong ba'i tshe/ dur khrod sogs rgyud nas gsungs pa'i gnas su/ ba'i rnam lnga dang dug khrag gis byugs pa'i stegs bu mda' gang mtho gang pa'i steng du rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor man ngag ltar bris pa'i steng du/ shar du rnam rgyal bum par lnga tshan lnga dang*/ sha lnga bdud rtsi lngas sbags pa'i rgyun 'bab kyi chu dang chang bzang pos sum gnyis bkang ba/ mgul chings nag po can kha rgyan gyi dbus su dung chu'am/

thod pa dri chus bkang ba'i steng du rdo rje la me tog gi srad bu btags pa/ las bum rdzas ldan kha rgyan mgul chings nag po byas pa/ lhor dbu rgyan/ nub tu rdor dril/ byang du gsang dbang gi thod par chang la a mṛ ta dang byang sems dkar dmar btab pa'i kha dar dmar dang me long bkab pa dang*/ shes rab ma'i gzugs sam dngos/ shar lhor yab yum sras sbas lha gnyis bya khyung dang bcas pa'i bris sku dang rak+sha'i phreng ba/ lho nub tu lha rnams kyi phyag mtshan dang lcags phur/ nub byang du thun rdzas liṅga/ byang du gtor zor mtshe yungs mda' mdung gis brgyan pa dang*/ drag po'i thab khung me 'bar ba/ mnan pa'i glang ru'i dbyibs dang*/ rdo rje rgya gram dang*/ ri rab bris pa dang*/ thod pa ja ril/ mdun du sman raka gtor ma/ sgos mchod spos/ mar me/ lha bshos gsum mdun du tshar gnyis dang*/ g.yas g.yon rgyab rnams su tshar re re/ spyi mchod shar du mchod yon rdzas bdun nas dang*/ 'o ma dang*/ me tog dkar po dang*/ til dang*/ 'bras yos dang*/ ku sha dang*/ bdud rtsi rnams so/ */mchan/ btab pa/ mer zhabs bsil chu dang 'o ma la me tog dkar po btab pa/ lhor me tog sna tshogs/ srin por bdug spos/ nub tu mar me/ rlung du dri sna tshogs sbyar ba'i dri chab/ byang du zhal zas/ dbang ldan du mtshams 'dzin gyi me tog rnams bshams/ slob dpon gyi mdun du lhag nas byas pa'i rdor dril/ thod rnga/ mig dar/ me tog /mig thur/ thod phor gyi nang du ro sol gyi me/ yi dwags kyi kha nas byung ba'i gu gul dang*/ bud med kyi 'doms dkris zla mtshan 'gos pa la byi la'i brun dang*/ sha lnga bdud rtsi'i lngas sbags pa sogs nyer mkho rnams bshams/ tshul 'di ni dbang bskur rgyas pa'i bca' gzhi ltar yin gyi/ 'bring dang bsdus pa la der mi mkho ba'i dbang rdzas rnams dor zhing*/ dbang bskur min pa'i sgrub mchod dang*/ rab gnas/

phrin las bzhi'i sbyin sreg sogs la ni de dang der mkho ba'i yo byad rnams bsags shing mi mkho ba rnams dor la/ thams cad la dkyil 'khor dang mchod pa sogs gong ltar bshams/ de ltar bshams zin nas de rnams la hūm̐ lan bdun dang gtso bo'i sngags bzlas la oṃ badz+ra s+pha ra ṇa khaṃ zhes brjod cing 'bul dgos so// gnyis pa dngos gzhi la gnyis/ lha sgrub pa dang*/ slob ma rjes su 'dzin cing dbang bskur ba'o// dang po la bdag mdun bum pa'o// dang po ni skyabs sems sngon du btang nas/ rdo rje hūm̐ las byung ba'i rdo rje sems dpa' yongs su gyur pa las/ thabs bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin rdo rjer gyur/ dril bu aḥlas byung ba'i rdo rje snyems ma yongs su gyur pa las shes rab stong pa nyid kyi rang bzhin dril bur gyur/ thal mo ā di kā dis yongs su gang ba las g.yas g.yon nyi ma dang zla bar gyur par mos/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sid+dhi badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha e ṣa s+t+waṃ dha ra yā mi badz+ra satwa hiḥ hi hi hi hi hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes g.yas pa'i mtheb srin gyis rdo rje snying gar bzung*/ oṃ badz+ra ghaṇ+ṭa hoḥ zhes g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis dril bu dku g.yon du kha nang du phyogs par bzung*/ slar rdo rje gong ltar la dril bu nang gi phyogs mtshams brgyad du lce skyod cing dkrol nas/ oṃ badz+ra dharma ra ṇi ta/ pra ra ṇi ta/ saṃ pra ra ṇi ta/ sarba bud+dha k+ṣe tra/ pra tsa li ni/ pradzñā pā ra mi tā/ nā da swa bhā wa badz+ra satwa hṛ da ya/ san+to ṣa ṇi hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ ho ho hoḥswā hā/ zhes brjod/ sngon 'gro'i gtor ma cha gsum chus bran la/ oṃ kā la rū pa ya ma rā dza hūm̐ phaṭ kyis bsangs/ oṃ swa bhā was sbyangs/ byin rlabs dang 'bul ba sogs phyogs skyong dang*/ gzhi bdag dang*/ bgegs la/ bka' brgyad bde gshegs 'dus pa'i sngon 'gro'i cha gsum ltar 'bul/ hūm̐ */

nga ni 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed// khros pa'i thugs ka'i 'phro 'du las// las kyi khro rgyal nam mkha' gang*// sprul pa'i khro mos bar snang gang*// sras kyi khro chung sa gzhi gang*// bgegs kyi sbyor ba rgyun chod cig /e ya mān+ta ka kro dha ya ma rā dza ma mo e ka tsa ti ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐ phaṭ gnod byed mā ra ya hur thuṃ rbad ya/ zhes mtshams bcad do// de rjes mchod pa bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūṃ las byung ba'i thod pa'i snod so sor oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i rdo rje'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog /bdug spos/ snang gsal/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha' dang mnyam par gyur par bsam/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐/ nas/ shapada'i bar sbyar/ skabs 'dir sman raka gnyis byin rlabs zla gsang 'dus pa'i tan+t+ra nas gsungs pa ltar khol bur bris yod pa ltar gyi byin rlabs bya dgos rgyu yin zhes pa 'di yin te| sman bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūṃ las bhan+dha lcang lo 'bar ba stong gsum dang mnyam pa'i nang du 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi pa'i lte ba dang*/ rtsibs bzhir nyi zla'i gdan re re gsal ba'i lte bar dri chen la oṃ las 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs brgyad pas mtshan pa/ rtsibs shar du byang sems la hūm̐ las rdo rje nag po rtse lnga pa/ lhor maṃ sa la swā las rin po che ser po zur brgyad pa/ nub tu pad+ma rak+ta la aṃ las pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa/ byang du dri chu la hā las rdo rje rgya gram ljang gu rnams kyis mtshan pa las phyag mtshan rnams 'bar zhing 'od du 'bar bas rdzas rnams zhu ba rigs lnga dam tshig gi bdud rtsir gyur pa'i steng du 'og nas rim bzhin hūm̐ nag po/ āḥdamar po/ oṃ dkar po rnams brtsegs mar gnas pa las so so'i 'od 'phros pas rigs snga yab yum ye shes kyi bdud rtsi dang bcas pa spyan drangs/

yi ge gsum la thim zhing*/ yi ge gsum 'og nas rim gyis zhu ba bdud rtsi la thim pas hūm̐ las bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin/ āḥlas ma chags yul las 'das pa/ oṃ las chos nyid stong gsal kun khyab rtsa brgyad yan lag stong dang ldan pa'i bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur par bsam zhing*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta hūm̐ hrīḥṭhāḥ zhes ci nus bzlas/ rak+ta bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūṃ las bhan+dha rlon pa lcang lor bcas pa stong gsum dang mnyam pa'i nang du zla gam dmar po dbang gi gdan steng du| pad+ma dmar po'i lte bar nyi 'od 'khyil ba'i dbus su/ ra yig dmar po 'od 'bar ba zhu ba las mū la rak+ta'i rgya mtshor 'khyil ba/ nyon mongs chags bral chos nyid dbyings kyi ngang*/ bsgrub pa'i dam rdzas chen po rak+ta'i rgya mtsho rba klong 'khrugs pa'i dbu ba las mchod pa'i lha mo dpag tu med pa 'phro bar gyur par bsams la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma hā rak+ta dz+wa la maṇ+ḍal hūm̐ hrīḥṭhāḥ zhes ci nus bzla'o| |sman rak+ta byin rlabs 'di gnyis zla gsang 'dus pa'i tan+t+ra'i rgyud kyi le'u bcu bdun par gsal por gsungs so// gshin rje tshe bdag gi yang zlog gi sman raka byin rlabs rnying ma'i las byang gzhan nas kha 'gengs pa las 'di nyid 'brel chags pa yin la nang mchod byin rlabs gzhan ltar sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga so sor 'dir ma mdzad pa ni bdud rtsi sman gyi sgrub pa'i skabs ltar dgongs pa yin 'dug pa rtsa brgyad yan lag stong sbyar gyi go don ltar 'di nyid legs pa yin no// gtor ma bsang sbyangs byas nas drag po'i gtor ma byin rlabs kyi sngags rgyas byin gyis brlabs nas/ oṃ ma hā ba ling+ta te dz+wa ba ling+ta ba la ba te gu h+ya sa ma ya hūm̐ hrīḥṭhāḥ gsum brjod/ sems bskyed pa ni/ rang nyid gshin rje'i gshed du gsal ba'i thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas/ phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba 'khor dang bcas pa bcom ldan 'das 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed 'khor dang bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi rnam par spyan drangs badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥ

oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ya ma rā dza sa pa ri wā ra pad+ma ka ma lā ye s+t+waṃ/ gong gi sa pa ri wā ra'i mthar/ pā da ban+da naṃ ka ro mi/ gong gi wā ra'i mthar/ ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ nas/ shapada'i bar gyis mchod/ yang wā ra'i mthar/ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta kha raṃ khā hi/ de bzhin du/ ma hā rak+ta la kha raṃ khā hi/ de bzhin du/ ma hā ba ling+ta kha raṃ khā hi/ zhes dbul/ chos sku skye ba med pas bstod/ slar/ sa gzhi spos byugs ma sogs maṇ+ḍal dang*/ yan lag bdun pa phul nas gzhan don gyi blos/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// sogs gsum dang*/ slar/ byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar// gsum gyis sems bskyed pa blangs/ mthar| deng dus bdag tshe sogs dang*/ da ni bdag gis sogs dang*/ bdag gis de ring skyob pa sogs dang*/ byang chub sems mchog rin po che// zhes pa'i sho lo ka rnams lan re re brjod/ tshogs zhing rnams rang la thim par gyur par bsam/ sems bskyed 'di skabs 'dir byas pas mdo sngags zung 'jug gi nyams len gnad zab pa yin no// bdag gi rnal 'byor dngos ni/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rgyas par bya ba dang*/ zhes pa nas/ 'od zer g.yas skor du yod par gyur gyi bar ngag 'don dkyus ltar byas rjes bsnyen pa la 'jug pa'i tshe/ ru rak+sha'i bgrang phreng rab gnas dang ldan pa 'dod chags gshin rje'i gshed bskyed bstims byas pa/ mchan/ bzung ste/ zla gsang gzhi bsnyen gyi bsnyen pa'i skabs kyi dmigs pa ltar ram yang na dmigs pa 'di ni gtso 'khor thams cad thun mong du sngags a kro sogs gsum po gang rung bzla ba'i dbang du byas kyi/ gtso 'khor so sor sngags bzla ba spro na gtso bo la 'di ga ltar dang yum gyi thugs kar bh+yoḥ sras dang 'chi bdag srog bdag gsum gyi thugs kar ya re re'i mthar so so'i sngags kyis bskor bar bsams la/ sngags byang logs su yod pa ltar bzla ba yin no// lha gtso 'khor thams cad kyi thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa'i lte bar hūm̐ mthing nag gi mthar sngags phreng gis bskor ba las 'od 'phros/

sems can gyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed kyi go 'phang la bkod/ slar 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i rgyal pa sras bcas bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong thams cad kyi byin rlabs nus mthu ma lus pa bsdus te sngags phreng la thim pas phrin las thams cad thogs med du 'grub par gyur par dmigs te/ sngags gsum po gang rung brgya stong khri 'bum gang 'grub bzla/ mthar/ ar+ghaṃ sogs dang*/ sman raka gtor mas mchod/ thabs mchog bde chen gyis bstod/ mthar/ rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ srung 'khor rnams mtha' nas rim gyis bsdus zhes pa nas/ phyag gnyis pa'i skur gsal bar gyur gyi bar bsdu ba'i rim pa la 'jug par bya'o| |gnyis pa mdun bskyed bsgrub pa ni/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa nas/ mthu rtsal dang ldan par gyur gyi bar ngag 'don dkyus ltar la rang nyid ces pa dor zhing*/ rang tshe bdag tu gsal ba'i thugs ka nas zhes pa'i mal du gtso 'khor thugs ka nas zhes 'don pa bsgyur/ sngags bzla ba'i tshe lha rnams kyi thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa'i lte bar hūm̐ bzlas pa'i dmigs pa 'di ni gtso 'khor thams cad thun mong du sngags a kro sogs bzla ba'i dbang du byas kyi/ gtso 'khor so sor sngags bzla bar spro na/ gtso bo la 'di ga ltar dang*/ 'khor rnams rang rang sa bon gyi mthar so so'i sngags kyis bskor bar bsams la sngags byang logs su yod pa ltar bzla'o// mthing nag gi mthar sngags phreng gis bskor ba las 'od 'phros/ 'gro ba'i don byas/ slar 'dus sngags phreng la thim par gyur par dmigs nas bzlas pa 'grub tshad bya/ mthar/ ar+ghaṃ sogs dang sman raka gtor mas mchod/ spro na rab 'byams ma che ba dang de'i shapada'i mthar bla med rdo rje theg pa'i don sogs sbyar bas mchod/ mchan/ bstod ring gis bstod do// lha'i lha mchog dang*/

bskal pa dpag tu med pa'i smon lam gdab| slob ma rjes 'dzin dang bdag 'jug len pa sogs ma gtogs las bzhi'i sbyin sreg la rnam rgyal bum pa mi dgos kyang thab sogs bsang sbyang dgos par las bum sgrub dgos so// las bzhi'i sbyin sreg dang*/ dus kyi mchod pa dang*/ tshogs 'khor gyi skabs la sogs par bum bskyed mi dgos pa'i skabs rnams kyi tshe mdun bskyed kyi mjug 'dir phyogs skyong gi gtor ma dang tshogs 'khor byas nas de'i rjes su mjug bsdu rjes chog rnams byed dgos pa yin no// gsum pa bum pa bsgrub pa ni/ bum pa gnyis bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūṃ las byung ba'i rin po che'i bum pa lto ba ldir ba/ zhabs zhum pa/ mgrin pa ring ba/ kha g.yel ba/ mchu 'phyang ba sogs mtshan nyid thams cad rdzogs shing nang du oṃ tap+te tap+te ma hā tap+te swā hā/ zhes bya bas drangs pa'i lha'i gaṅgā'i chu'i ngo bo bcud kyis gang ba gnyis las/ rnam rgyal bum pa'i nang du bum mtshan ya ma ti ra baṃ zhes pa nas/ rbad ya zlog ya zhes pas bskor bar gyur gyi bar ngag 'don dkyus ltar la rang nyid dang*/ rang tshe bdag sogs mdun bskyed ltar 'don pa bsgyur/ las bum gyi nang dang bum mtshan pad nyi dgra bgegs kyi gdan la ya mthing nag las skyes pa'i las kyi gshin rje dmar nag /zhal gcig /phyag gnyis/ ral pa kham nag zur gsum gyen du 'phyo ba/ spyan gsum dmar zhing 'khrugs pa/ smin ma dang sma ra ag tshom rnams me ltar 'bar ba/ mche ba gtsigs shing ljags 'gyur hūm̐ gi sgra sgrog pa/ sbom thung gsus pa 'phyang zhing mi sdug pa rus pa dang sbrul gyis brgyan cing*/ sku stod la mi lpags kyi g.yang gzhi dang sku smad la stag gi sham thabs grol ba/ g.yas be con brdeg pa'i tshul dang*/ g.yon thugs kar sdigs mdzub dgra bgegs kyi don snying 'drad pa'i tshul gyis zhags pa 'dzin pa/ zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang ba'i bskal pa dus mtha'i me 'bar ba'i klong na bzhugs par gyur/

lha tshogs thams cad kyi spyi bor 'khor lo dkar po oṃ gyis mtshan pa nas/ mthu rtsal dang ldan par gyur gyi bar ngag 'don dkyus ltar sbyar/ sngags bzla ba'i tshe gzung thag la 'jus te/ rang gi thugs ka nas sngags phreng spros/ gzung thag la brgyud de song*/ bum nang gi lha gtso 'khor gyi thugs kar nyi ma'i dbus su rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa'i lte bar hūm̐ mthing nag gi mthar sngags phreng gis bskor ba la thim pas thugs rgyud bskul/ sngags phreng sa bon dang bcas pa las bdud rtsi bab pas bum pa gang bar gyur par bsam nas sngags gsum po ci 'grub bzla/ slar gzung thag las bum gyi khar spos la/ rang gi thugs ka nas 'od 'phros/ gzung thag la 'khril te song*/ las bum gyi lha'i thugs kar nyi ma'i dbus su rdo rje nag po rtse lnga pa'i lte bar hūm̐ dmar nag gi mthar sngags kyis bskor ba la phog pas thugs rgyud bskul/ dgra bgegs thams cad bcom zhing phrin las thams cad thogs med du sgrub pa'i mthu rtsal dang ldan par gyur par dmigs nas/ oṃ kā la rū pa ya ma rā dza hūm̐ phaṭ/ ces pa ci 'grub bzla/ mthar bum pa gnyis kyi lha la ar+ghaṃ sogs dang sman raka gtor mas mchod/ spro na chos dbyings ye shes rang bzhin rnam dag sogs kyi shapada'i mthar/ bla med rdo rje theg pa sogs sbyar bas mchod/ gtso bum la/ gru gsum mthing nag mas bstod/ las bum la/ e ya/ dpag tshad brgyad khri'i pha rol na// 'byung ba bzhi yi 'og rol na// rgya mtsho'i gling gi bar shed na// 'chi bdag nyi zla'i 'od zer can// nag po 'char ka zhes kyang bya// bye ba dgu khri zhes kyang bya// chos kyi rgyal po zhes kyang bya// a wa glang mgo zhes kyang bya// bde gshegs sprul sku ngo bo nyid// 'jam dpal nyid las ma g.yos te// gdul bya'i don du dmyal ba 'dul// dmar nag gzugs thung gsus po che// lhu gzugs thung la rab tu sbom// mig ni dmar la zlum por log

/dri mi zhim la brda mi 'phrod// rab tu gtum pa'i gzugs can zhig /srid pa gsum po lto na 'chang*// dge sdig gnyis kyi bya ra byed// gson gshin gnyis kyi zam kha po// 'gro ba kun gyi dus mtha' ru// srog la dbang byed 'chi bdag byed// rigs sngags 'khrul 'khor sku la gnas// dus ma yin par srog la 'bebs// mthu stobs can la bstod par bgyi// zhes sdeb rgyud nas gsungs pas bstod/ mthar rnam rgyal bum pa'i lha rnams byang chub sems kyi ngo bor zhu ba bum pa'i chu dang dbyer med du gyur/ 'khyil pa bzlas pa'i me tog dkar po gsum rnam rgyal nang du bzhugs/ nyer spyod lngas mchod cing bsrung ba'i don du las bum gyi chus bsangs shing de'i sngags brjod do// las bum gyi lhas 'dir ji srid dbang bskur ram rab gnas sam sbyin sreg sogs che ge mo'i bya ba ma rdzogs kyi bar du bgegs rnams srung zhing zlog par mdzod cig /ces bsgo/ lha yi lha mchog dang bskal pa dpag tu med pa'i smon lam gdab/ rnam rgyal steng gi dung zhal mna' chu'i slad du de nyid du bzhag go// phyogs skyong gi gtor ma nang mchod ltar byin brlabs la/ oṃ kā la rū pa ya ma rā dza ṣaṣ+ṭhi ḍā ki nī pañtsa da sha diklo ka pā la sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs spyan drangs/ gong gi sngags mthar/ ar+ghaṃ nas shapada'i bar btags pas mchod/ yang gong gi sngags mthar/ a kā ro btags pa lan bdun gyis gtor ma phul la/ las kyi gshin rje pho nyar bcas// mkha' 'gro drug cu rtsa bzhi dang*// phyogs skyong bco lnga 'khor bcas rnams// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la// nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun grub mdzod kyi bar gyis gtor ma phul/ yi ge brgya pas nongs pa bshags/ mkha' 'gro phyogs skyong rang gnas su gshegs su gsol/ tshul 'di rnams ni yang zlog gi srung zlog bsad mnan las sbyor gyi sgrub pa ma gtogs/

skabs gzhan dbang bskur rab gnas sbyin sreg sgrub mchod dang 'brel ba// mchan/ sgrub mchod bdag nyid 'jug pa sogs thams cad la gal che ba'i phyir zhib tu bris so// gnyis pa slob ma rjes su 'dzin slob ma sta gon sogs lhan thabs su bshad pa ltar bya ba gal che'o// mchan/ cing dbang bskur ba la gnyis/ bdag nyid 'jug pa dang*/ slob ma 'jug pa'o// dang po ni/ gtso bo las spros pa'i las kyi gshin rjes slob dpon gyi bya ba mdzad par dmigs nas dkyil 'khor gyi phyi 'jug nas brtsam/ slob ma la dbang rgyas 'bring bsdus pa ji tsam bskur ba de nyid skabs 'dir rang gis blangs nas las gshin de nyid rang la thim par bsams la| slob dpon gyi las la gnang ba zhu ba ni 'di ltar mkhyen par gsol te/ bdag ming che ge zhes bya yi// he ru ka dpal slob dpon che// sangs rgyas byang chub sems kun gyis// gsungs pa'i cho ga bdag gi ni| |phun sum tshogs pa'i cho ga yis// sems can don ni bdag gis bgyi// de la rjes gnang stsol mdzod la// sangs rgyas byang chub sems rnams kyis// bdag la nye bar mdzad du gsol| |zhes gnang ba zhus pas/ de ltar gyis shig ces gnang ba bstsal bar bsam mo// de nas slob ma gzhug pa'i phyir dkyil 'khor gyi dngos grub zhu zhing bden pa'i byin rlabs bya ba ni/ rdor dril 'dzin pas/ sems can kun gyi snying la zhugs// sems can kun gyi yab gyur nyid// 'dod chags dam tshig mchog gyur pa'i// bden pa gang gi ye shes mchog /shes rab thabs dag dkyil 'khor yin// bden pa de yis mgon khyod kyis// bdag gi 'dod pa rab rdzogs mdzod// chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste// dag cing gsal la rnyog pa med// gzung du med cing brjod du med// rgyu dang las las kun tu byung*// de bzhin nyid las nges par skye// bden pa de yi dkyil 'khor du// gzugs brnyan gsal bar slob ma ni// kun gyis sgrib med mthong bar shog

/ces lan gsum brjod| |slob ma rjes 'dzin byed na bden pa'i byin rlabs kyi mjug 'dir tshogs mchod byas nas tshogs la longs spyod pa dang*/ lhag gtor slob ma la dbang bskur grub nas bya/ yang slob ma la dbang bskur mi byed par rang bdag 'jug len na skabs 'dir 'og nas 'byung ba ltar dbang rgyas pa'am bsdu na sngags tsam gyis blangs la tshogs dang rjes kyi bya ba rnams bya/ gnang ba zhu ba dang bden pa'i byin rlabs 'don mi dgos so// gnyis pa/ dpal zla gsang nag po'i rgyud kyi le'u drug pa 'bras bu mngon byung dbang gi le'u las/ de nas bu rnams khrus byas te// phyag 'tshal gsol gdab rim par rdzogs// bum pa dbu rgyan cod pan dang*// rdo rje dril bu ming dang ni// brtul zhugs mthar thug bar du sbyin// rnam grangs rim pa lnga yis rdzogs// zhes gsungs pa bzhin rim pa bzhin du bskur ba ni/ slob ma gzhug pa la gnyis/ dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa dang*/ zhugs pa la dbang bskur ba'o// dang po la gsum/ gdong g.yogs dang bcas nas gzhug pa dang*/ nang du gzhug pa/ dkyil 'khor mthong ba'i bdag nyid du gzhug pa'o// dang po la gnyis/ phyi rol du gzhug pa dang*/ nang du gzhug pa'o// dang po ni/ dkyil 'khor yol bas bsgribs pa'i phyi rol du mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i slob ma zung du ma gyur pa gral la bkod pa la/ slob dpon gyis las bum thogs te khrus byed du bcug cing*/ bdag gi dam tshig 'jam dpal te// rin chen dngul gyi bum pa ru// byang chub sems kyi bdud rtsis bkang*// nyon mongs bag chags byang gyur cig /oṃ kā la rū pa ya ma rā dza u da ka snān sarba pā paṃ bi shud+dhe swā hā/ zhes brjod/ las kyi rdo rjes me tog bkram zhing bsdu/ slob ma rnams kyis 'jug /yon dang maṇ+ḍal phul nas/ slob ma rnam snang gi nga rgyal dang ldan pas/ dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa ste// slob dpon khyod ni dgongs su gsol// byang chub chen po'i tshul bstan pa// mgon po chen po bdag 'tshal lo// dam tshig de nyid bdag la stsol// byang chub sems kyang bdag la stsol// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te// skyabs gsum dag kyang bdag la stsol// thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu// mgon pos bdag ni gzhug tu gsol// zhes gsum gyis gsol ba btab|

dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// sdig pa mi dge so sor bshags// 'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rang*// sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis bzung*// sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mchog la// byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi// rang gzhan don ni rab bsgrub phyir// byang chub sems ni bskyed par bgyi// byang chub mchog gi sems ni bskyed bgyis nas// sems can thams cad bdag gis mgron du gnyer// byang chub spyod mchog yid 'ong spyad par bgyi// 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /gsum gyis rgyun bshags byas la/ bshad rgyud khri drug pa'i le'u sum brgya gcig par gsungs pa'i thun mong ma yin pa'i yan lag brgyad pa logs su bris yod pa 'dir rjes zlos lan gsum bya'o// zlum gtor gsum dang*/ ting lo/ chang bu sbrags pa gsum rnams chus sbyangs/ a kā ro lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs nas gtor chung re g.yas su bskor zhing*/ sarba bigh+nāṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yo bi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥsogs sngags re brjod cing gtor ma gsum gsog snod du dor/ de rjes ting lo re re g.yon du bskor zhing*/ oṃ suṃ bha ni'i sngags re dang bcas gsog snod du blugs/ mthar bden stobs brjod cing slob ma la yungs kar gyis brab/ gu gul bdug /drag sngags bzlas la bgegs dang bral bar bya'o// slob dpon gyis sdom pa bsgrag pa ni/ dkon mchog gsum gzung sangs rgyas rigs// rdor dril slob dpon gzung rdo rje// sbyin pa rnam bzhi rin chen rigs// dam chos gsum gzung pad+ma ste// mchod pa rnams ni las kyi rigs// de ltar rigs lngar bcu bzhi dang*// slob dpon smod dang bde gshegs bka' las 'da'// spun khro byams pa spong dang byang sems spangs// grub mtha' smod dang gsang sgrog phung por brnyas// som nyi gdug la byams dang ming med rtogs// sun 'byin dam rdzas mi bsten bud med smod// de dag rtsa ba'i ltung ba bcu bzhir bshad// shes rab stobs kyis len dang bdud rtsi stobs kyis len| |snod min gsang sgrog tshogs kyi 'khor lor rtsod pa dang*// dad ldan las gzhan chos ston nyan thos nang du bsdad// rdzun gyi nga rgyal dad med mi la chos ston dang*// 'di rnams sbom po'i ltung ba brgyad ces rab tu grags// khyad par bsrung ba nyer gcig dang*// lta sgom spyod dang sku gsung thugs// gzhan yang yan lag ltung ba'i tshogs// rjes mthun sdom pa rgya cher ni| |gsang ba'i rgyud las rab tu bshad// khyod kyis rtag tu bsrung bar bya// zhes bsgrags/

slob mas de rnams 'dzin 'dod kyi bsam pas/ sangs rgyas sras bcas thams cad dang*// dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma rnams kun// bdag la dgongs par mdzad du gsol// bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba yis// dus 'di nas ni bzung nas su// ji srid byang chub snying po'i bar// ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams// byang chub tu ni nges mdzad pa'i// byang chub sems ni bla na med// dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi// tshul khrims kyi ni bslab pa dang*// dge ba'i chos rnams sdud pa dang*// sems can don byed tshul khrims gsum// so sor brtan por gzung bar bgyi// sangs rgyas rnal 'byor sdom pa la// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te// bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum| |dengs nas brtsams te gzung bar bgyi// rdo rje rigs mchog chen po la// rdo rje dril bu'i phyag rgya yang*// yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi/ /slob dpon dag kyang gzung bar bgyi// rin chen rigs mchog chen po yi// dam tshig yid du 'ong ba la// nyin re bzhin yang dus drug tu// sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin// byang chub chen po las byung ba'i// pad+ma'i rigs chen dag pa la// phyi nang gsang ba theg pa gsum// dam pa'i chos ni ma lus gzung*// las kyi rigs mchog chen po la// sdom pa thams cad ldan par ni// yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi// mchod pa'i las ni ci nus bgyi// byang chub sems ni bla na med// dam pa bdag gis bskyed bgyis nas// sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir// bdag gis sdom pa ma lus gzung*// ma bsgral ba rnams bsgral bar bgyi// ma grol ba rnams dgrol bar bgyi// dbugs ma phyin rnams dbugs dbyung zhing*// sems can mya ngan 'das la 'god// gsum gyis sdom pa gzung*/ bshad rgyud khri drug stong pa'i le'u sum brgya gcig par thun mong ma yin pa'i rigs lnga'i sdom gzung zur du bris yod pa ltar 'dir rjes zlos lan gsum bya'o// oṃ tsak+ṣurbahan+dha wa ra mā na ya hūm̐ gis gdong bcings/

a khaṃ bā'i ra hūm̐ gis me tog gi phreng ba gtad/ las bum gyi chus las sngags bzla zhing bsrung*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes bdud rtsi lce thog tu bzhag pas kyang bsrung*/ slob dpon gyis/ bu khyod su yin ci la dga'// zhes 'dri/ slob mas/ skal bzang bdag bde ba chen po la'o// zhes lan gdab/ slar slob dpon gyis/ de yis bu la ci zhig bya// zhes 'dri/ slob mas/ sangs rgyas mchog gi dam tshig go// zhes brjod/ sems bskyed pa ni/ slob ma'i snying gar kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi ngo bo zla ba nya gang ba'i dbus su don dam byang chub kyi ngo bo rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pas mtshan pa bsgom du bcug la/ oṃ sarba yo ga tsit+ta ut+pā da yā mi/ zhes slob mas brjod/ slob dpon gyis rdo rje me tog dang bcas pa slob ma'i snying gar bzung la/ oṃ su ra te sa ma ya s+t+waṃ hoḥ sid+dhi badz+ra ya thā su khaṃ/ zhes byin gyis brlabs/ gsang bar gdams pa ni/ rdo rje slob ma'i mgor bzhag nas/ deng khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi byin gyis rlob kyi/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi mchog tu gsang ba 'di khyod kyis dkyil 'khor du ma zhugs pa rnams la smra bar mi bya zhing ma dad pa rnams la'ang ma yin no// zhes gdams/ gnyis pa nang du gzhug pa ni/ slob ma mig dar dang ldan pa'i lag tu slob dpon gyis rdo rje gtad la/ oṃ āḥya mān+ta kṛta hūm̐ hūm̐ dzaḥhūm̐/ zhes brjod cing yol ba'i nang du khrid la/ slob dpon gyis/ a khaṃ zhes gral la bzhag gam de ltar mos par bya/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta gu ru tsa ra ṇa badz+ra satwa bai ro tsa na badz+ra rat+na badz+ra dharma badz+ra karma u pa s+thā nā ya āt+ma nāṃ nirayā ta yā mi/ zhes slob mas slob dpon dang lha la phyag bya/ phan yon gyi sgo nas dam bzhag ni/ slob dpon gyis rdo rje bu'i mgor bzhag nas/ deng khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rigs su zhugs kyi/

des na ngas khyod la rdo rje'i ye shes bskyed par bya ste/ ye shes gang gis khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dngos grub kyang thob par 'gyur na/ dngos grub gzhan rnams lta smos kyang ci dgos/ khyod kyis kyang dkyil 'khor ma mthong ba'i mdun du smra bar mi bya ste/ smras na khyod dam tshig nyams par 'gyur ta re/ zhes brjod/ nyes dmigs kyi sgo nas dam bzhag ni/ rdo rje me tog dang bcas slob ma'i snying gar bzung ste/ oṃ/ de ring 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed// khyod kyi snying la yang dag zhugs// gal te tshul 'di smras na ni// de ma thag tu dral te gshegs// zhes brjod nas/ gnyis ka'i sgo nas dam bzhag ni/ rnam rgyal steng gi dung zhal gyi chu bu'i lce thog tu bzhag la/ 'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu// dam tshig nyams na sreg par byed// dam tshig bsrung na dngos grub ster// rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu 'thung zhig /oṃ pañtsa a mṛ ta u da ka ṭha ṭha ṭhaḥ zhes sbyin/ slob dpon bka' gnyan pa'i sgo nas dam bzhag ni/ rdo rje bu'i mgor bzung la/ deng nas bzung ste khyod kyi 'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa' nga yin gyi ngas 'di gyis shig ces gang bsgo ba de khyod kyis bya dgos so// khyod kyis nga la brnyas par mi bya ste/ khyod ya nga ba ma spangs pa 'chi ba'i dus byas na rdo rje'i dmyal bar ltung bar 'gyur ta re/ zhes brjod/ ye shes dbab pa ni/ slob ma skad cig gis stong pa nyid kyi rjes su āḥlas byung ba'i gsung rdo rje gshin rje'i gshed dmar po/ g.yas pad+ma dang*/ g.yon de'i yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa g.yas brkyang gis bzhengs par bskyed nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis byin gyis rlobs shig /'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa' bdag la dbab du gsol/ zhes gsum brjod/ ye shes dbab pa'i tshe slob ma'i lus gnad g.yas brkyang ngam tsog pu rkang pa'i brang la lus ljid bkal/

lag snying gar thal mo sbyar/ ngag gi gnad steng rlung 'og rlung gnyis ka bsdams/ yid kyi gnad dus gsum gyi rtog pa thams cad bcad de dmigs pa la sgrim pa gal che bar gsungs so// slob ma'i snying khar laṃ las sa yi dkyil 'khor ser po gru bzhi pa rdo rjes mtshan pa nyi ma la hūm̐ sngon po/ mgo bor baṃ las chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po bum pas mtshan pa zla ba la haḥdakar po/ mgrin par yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po gzhu lta bu ba dan g.yo ba gnyis kyis mtshan pa zla ba la āḥdamar po/ lte bar raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum pa yi ge ras mtshan pa/ rkang zhabs su yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor ljang gu gzhu lta bu dzhaiḥdrag po me 'bar ba'i dzhaiḥ'i me rlung gi lte ba'i bar du bus pas lte ba'i me dkyil las me 'bar bas snying gi sa bsregs te lus drod kyi rang bzhin dang*/ mgo bo'i chu khol nas bdud rtsi 'dzag pas sa dkyil la bab pas bde ba'i rang bzhin dang bde drod gnyis po'i rkyen gnyis rang sems yul snang thams cad bde stong du thim zhing dzhaiḥme rlung gis 'degs bzhin pa la/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba thams cad 'jam dpal phyag rgya zil gnon gyi dkyil 'khor gyi rnam par spyan drangs pa slob ma'i spyi bo nas bcug cing bstims nas/ slob ma'i rkang pa'i bu ga nas dzhaiḥ'i 'od zer gyi tshogs zhugs pa las 'od zer gyis lus mtha' dag kun nas gang bar gyur par dpon slob gnyis kas bsams shing*/ slob dpon gyi g.yon pas dril bu dkrol zhing g.yas rdo rje dang bcas pa'i dur sol gyi me la sngar gyi rdzas sbyar ba rnams bsregs pa'i spos phor bteg pa bu la bdug bzhin pas/ oṃ tiṣ+ṭha ma hā kro dha ā we sha ya hūm̐/ oṃ shrī he ru kā ya bid+ma he bid+yā ya rā dzā ya dhīḥm he swā hā/

ya ma rā dza ā we sha ya s+t+waṃ bha ya/ ra ra ra ra/ tsa la ya tsa la ya hūm̐ ha āḥdzhaiḥ zhes dbab cing rol mo drag tu bya'o// ma phebs na spog chog gzhan ltar bya'o// 'di dbang gi rmang rdo lta bu yin pas gal shin tu che'o// de nyid tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra dang*/ rdo rje rgya gram gyis brtan par bya'o// de nas slob mar dkyil 'khor gyi thad kyi bar snang khru gang tsam du bltar bcug la/ khyod kyi mig la ji ltar snang zhes 'dri/ slob mas/ dkar ser dmar ljang khra bor snang ngo*/ gang zer rim pas zhi rgyas dbang drag sna tshogs pa'i dngos grub la skal pa dang ldan par go bar bya/ slob ma'i mthe bong nas rdo rje dang bcas pas lag pas bzung nas| rdo rje'i rkang stabs kyis las sngags brjod cing dkyil 'khor la skor ba lan gsum byas rjes/ slob dpon rdor dril 'dzin pas bden pa'i byin rlabs ni/ yang dag pa yi dkyil 'khor 'dir// bdag gis slob ma gzhug pa 'di'i| |lha rnams rigs kyi rim pa ni// bsod nams ji lta de ltar shog /'di yi dngos grub ji 'drar 'gyur// rigs ni gang gi snod du 'gyur// bsod nams mthu yang ci 'dra ba// de 'dra dkyil 'khor du gyur cig /ces brjod/ de nas slob mas me tog thogs 'khor lo'i gtso bo'i dbu la phul bar dmigs nas/ pra tīts+tsha ku su māñdza li nā tha hoḥ zhes dor/ de yang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i mdzod spu'am dbu'i gtsug tor la bab na phyag chen/ spyan nam zhal la sngags kyi dngos grub/ sku'i stod smad bar gsum la dngos grub mchog dman bar ma/ sku las ring na yun ring po nas dngos grub 'thob/ lha gnyis kyi bar du lhung na gang dang nye ba de'i rigs dang*/ mnyam na gnyis ka'am gang la dad pa de'i rigs/ srung 'khor gyi phyir lhung na dngos grub mi 'thob cing skal pa med pas re zhig dkyil 'khor mi bstan par sdig pa bshags pa sogs la 'bad dgos so// zhes brda sbyar/

me tog de nyid slob dpon gyis thogs la slob ma'i mgor bcings te/ oṃ pra ti gṛh+ṇa s+t+waṃ i maṃ satwa ma hā ba la/ zhes brjod/ gnyis pa dkyil 'khor mthong ba'i bdag nyid can du gzhug pa ni/ slob ma'i snying gar zla ba la bdag po'i sa bon hūm̐/ dpral bar raṃ/ mig gnyis su 'bar ba dang bcas pa'i oṃ re gsal btab nas/ slob dpon gyis/ oṃ/ de ring 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed// khyod kyi mig ni 'byed par brtson// rdo rje'i mig ni bla na med// thams cad mig ni 'byed par mdzad// oṃ dzñā na tsak+ṣuḥhūm̐ āḥswā hā/ zhes brjod cing gdong g.yogs bsal/ he badz+ra pa sh+ya/ zhes lta bar bskul nas/ bsrung ba'i gur khang rim pa bcu gsum gyi dbus su/ byang chub chen po'i mchod rten gyi bum nang du gser gyi rdo rje rgya gram gyi nang du shel gyi rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i lte bar gshin rje pho mo ma he chu glang pad+ma nyi zla'i steng du 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed phyag rgya zil gnon dang*/ de'i g.yon du yum ma mo khrag mig ma/ g.yas su sras mchog ya ma rā tsa/ mdun du sku sprul 'chi bdag nag po/ rgyab tu gsung sprul srog bdag nag po/ de rnams la 'khor gshin rje ma mo sde brgyad 'jig rten dregs pa'i tshogs til gyi gang bu kha phye ba lta bus bskor nas bzhugs pa la dkyil 'khor chen po rten dang brten par bcas pa mngon sum du mthong bar ngo sprad do// gnyis pa dkyil 'khor du zhugs pa la dbang bskur ba ni/ spyi dang*/ bye brag /khyad par gsum mo// dang po ni/ rdo rje slob ma'i dbang dang*/ slob dpon gyi dbang gnyis so// dang po yon dang maṇ+ḍal phul/ byang chub rdo rjes gsol ba btab nas/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i hūm̐ gi 'od kyis slob ma 'od kyi rang bzhin du byas pa bkug /slob dpon gyi zhal du zhugs/ thugs kar rjes chags kyi mes bzhus te byang chub kyi sems su gyur pa rdo rje'i lam nas spros pa mdun du gnas par gyur par dmigs/

til dang me chus rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i sbyin sreg gis sdig pa sbyong ba cho ga gzhan nas 'byung ba ltar skabs 'dir bya ba gal che'o// slob ma dang bum chu bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pad nyi'i gdan la slob ma dang dbang rdzas hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros/ don gnyis byas 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ zhe sdang gshin rje'i gshed mthing nag /nag dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum/ phyag drug gi g.yas gsum rdo rje dang g.yon gsum dril bu 'dzin pa/ dur khrod kyi chas dang dpal gyi chas brgyad kyis brgyan pa/ zhabs bzhi g.yon brkyang gis bsgyings pa/ yum mā ma kī sngon mo gri thod 'dzin pa dang mnyam dbang rdzas bskyed pa yan lag bzhi rdzogs ni stong sbyang nas 'di man chad bsnyen pa'i yan lag /par sbyor ba'i gnas gsum yi ge gsum gyis mtshan pa las yi ge gsum gyis sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlabs pa nye bar bsgrub pa'i yan lag 'od 'phros/ bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par gyur/ ye shes pa spyan 'dren dgug gzhug bcing*/ slar yang snying ga'i sa mnyes par bsgrub pa'i yan lag /bon gyi 'od kyis sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' nam mkha' gang bar spyan drangs/ slar dbang lha spyan drangs gsol ba btab pas/ dbang rdzas kyi lha la dbang bskur rgyas btab nas zhu ba dbang rdzas su gyur pa ni sgrub pa chen po'i yan lag ste de ltar dbang so sor yan lag bzhi rdzogs su bskyed pa ni rigs dbang 'og ma bzhi la'ang shes par bya'o// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñtsa tu māṃ/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa de rnams kyis bdag dang dbang rdzas kyi dbang lha la dbang bskur/ chu rgyun gyis lus gang*/ rigs bdag gis rgyas btab nas/ dbang rdzas kyi lha yab yum snyoms 'jug gi bde bas zhu ba dbang rdzas kyi rnam par gyur/

slar yang slob ma'i yan lag bzhi ni 'di nas/ nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams la dbang bskur ba'i slad du/ rdo rje can gyis sangs rgyas la// 'gro ba'i skyob pa'i ched du dbang*// yon tan 'byung gnas ji ltar bstsal// de ltar 'di la'ang bstsal du gsol| |zhes gsol ba slob dpon gyis btab pas/ mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor pas dbang bskur ba'i dgongs pa mdzad/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis dbang rdzas bsnams pa la/ slob mas/ bcom ldan de bzhin gshegs pa kun// bcom ldan bdag nyid chen po rnams// thugs rje'i rang bzhin can rnams kyi// khyod kyis bdag la dbang bskur cig /ces gsol ba btab pa la dbang bskur bar mos nas/ slob dpon gyis bum pa thogs nas/ dbang bskur rdo rje chen po ni// khams gsum pa yis phyag byas pa// sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang gsum gyi// gnas las byung ba sbyin par bya// oṃ āḥbadz+rod ka a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ su ra te s+t+waṃ a haṃ/ zhes bum pa mgor bzhag nas bum chu sbyin/ de ltar dbang bskur ba'i chu rgyun gyis lus thams cad gang*/ chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las dpral ba'i steng du mi bskyod pa yab yum gyis dbu brgyan/ dbang gi lha rnams slob ma'i lus la thim pa la/ nyer spyod lngas mchod/ 'di yan slob ma'i yan lag bzhi/ des mi bskyod pa gshin rje'i gshed chu'i dbang bskur ba thob/ zhe sdang gi dri ma dag /rnam par shes pa'i phung po gnas bsgyur/ me long lta bu'i ye shes mngon du byas/ mi bskyod pa'i sa bon dang bag chags rgyud la bzhag /de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi thugs kyi byin rlabs zhugs/ rdo rje'i rigs kyi dngos grub dang phrin las bsgrub pa la dbang ngo*// zhes go ba bskyed do// dbu rgyan dang slob ma sngar ltar las/ aṃḥlas rin po che aṃḥgis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las/ nga rgyal gshin rje'i gshed ser nag

/ser dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum/ phyag drug gi g.yas gsum rin po che dang g.yon gsum sogs/ yum rin chen sgrol ma ser mo gri thod 'dzin pa dang sogs nas/ dbang bskur bar mos nas kyi bar gong ltar byas la/ slob dpon gyis dbu rgyan mgo bo'i dbus dang g.yas g.yon mdun rgyab tu rim pa bzhin/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta satwa badz+ri a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ/ oṃ badz+ra dhā twī shwa rī a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ oṃ rat+na badz+ri a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ oṃ dharma badz+ri a bhi ṣiñtsa hrīḥ oṃ karma badz+ri a bhi ṣiñtsa trāṃ/ zhes sngags lngas mgo la bskon/ de nas/ dbang bskur rdo rje chen po ni// sogs dang*/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra mu ku ṭa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ su ra te s+t+waṃ a haṃ/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ zhes chu dbang bskur/ chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las rna ltag g.yas su rin chen 'byung ldan yab yum gyis dbu brgyan par sogs gong ltar bya/ des rin chen 'byung ldan gshin rje'i gshed dbu rgyan gyi dbang bskur ba thob/ nga rgyal gyi dri ma dag /tshor ba'i phung po gnas bsgyur/ mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes mngon du byas/ rin chen 'byung ldan gyi sa bon dang bag chags rgyud la bzhag /yon tan gyi byin rlabs zhugs/ rin po che'i rigs kyi dngos grub dang phrin las bsgrub pa la dbang ngo*// zhes go ba bskyed/ slob ma dang dbang rdzas rdo rje sngar ltar las/ 'di la nges par rdo rje rtse dgu pa dgos par gsungs so// hrīḥlas pad+ma hrīḥs mtshan pa las 'dod chags gshin rje'i gshed dmar nag /dmar dkar sngo ba'i zhal gsum/ phyag drug gi g.yas gsum pad+ma g.yon gsum sogs/ yum gos dkar mo dmar mo gri thod 'dzin pa dang sogs nas/ dbang bskur bar mos nas kyi bar sngar ltar la/ slob dpon gyis rdo rje rtse dgu pa thogs nas/ dbang bskur rdo rje sogs tshigs bcad kyi mthar/ sangs rgyas rnams kyi rdo rje yi// dbang 'di de ring khyod dbang bskur// 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad nyid// rdo rje rab tu 'grub phyir zung*// oṃ āḥbadz+ra a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/

su ra te s+t+waṃ a haṃ/ zhes rdo rje slob ma'i snying mgrin dpral bar reg cing lag g.yas su gtad/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe sogs kyis bum chu sbyin/ chu lhag ma yar lud pa las ltag par 'od dpag med yab yum gyis dbu brgyan pa sogs sngar ltar bya/ des 'od dpag med gshin rje'i gshed rdo rje'i dbang bskur ba thob/ 'dod chags kyi= 'du shes kyi= so sor rtog pa'i= 'od dpag med kyi= gsung gi byin rlabs= pad+ma'i rigs kyi dngos grub dang phrin las bsgrub pa la dbang ngo*// zhes sbyar zhing go ba bskyed/ slob ma dang dbang rdzas sngar ltar las/ dril bu 'di'ang nges par rdo rje rtse dgu pas yu ba byas pa'i dril bu dgos so// khaṃ las ral gri khaṃ gis mtshan pa las phrag dog gshin rje'i gshed ljang nag /ljang dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum/ phyag drug gi g.yas gsum rgya gram dang g.yon gsum sogs/ yum dam tshig sgrol ma ljang gu gri thod 'dzin sogs nas/ dbang bskur bar mos nas kyi bar sngar ltar la/ slob dpon gyis dril bu thogs nas/ dbang bskur rdo rje sogs tshigs bcad kyi mthar/ oṃ/ dril bu rdo rje rab ldan pa// shin tu dpa' bo nyid dbang bskur// rdo rje'i dam tshig gnas pa khyod// bdag po'i dbang bskur rgyal nos shig /oṃ badz+ra a dhi pa ti twaṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa mi/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ zhes dril bu slob ma'i g.yon du gtad| slob mas/ oṃ badz+ra ghaṇ+ṭa aḥ bcom ldan bzung ngo bdag la ni// yang dag nye bar gyur par mdzod// ces brjod cing dril bu smin mtshams su lan gsum dkrol te dku g.yon du bzung*/ rdo rje snying gar lag pa g.yas pas 'dzin du bcug /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sogs kyis bum chu sbyin/ chu lhag ma yar lud pa las rna ltag g.yon du don yod grub pa yab yum gyis dbu brgyan pa sogs sngar ltar bya/ des don yod grub pa gshin rje'i gshed dril bus dbang bskur ba thob/

phrag dog gi= 'du byed kyi= bya ba grub pa'i= don yod grub pa'i= phrin las kyi byin= las kyi rigs kyi dngos grub dang phrin las bsgrub pa la dbang ngo*// zhes sbyar zhing go ba bskyed/ de nas/ slob ma dang rdor dril sngar ltar las/ 'di la rtse lnga dgu gang byung 'dra ba yin no// oṃ las 'khor lo oṃ gyis mtshan pa las gti mug gshin rje'i gshed dkar sngo dmar ba'i zhal gsum/ phyag drug gi g.yas gsum 'khor lo dang g.yon gsum sogs/ yum sangs rgyas spyan ma dkar mo gri thod 'dzin pa sogs nas/ dbang bskur bar mos nas kyi bar sngar ltar la| slob dpon gyis rdor dril mnyam por slob ma'i spyi bor thogs nas/ dbang bskur rdo rje sogs tshigs bcad kyi mthar/ rdo rje ming gi dbang bskur bas// rtag pa'i rdo rjer rab bzhugs nas// mi shigs rdo rje'i ming ldan par// bu khyod de ring dbang bskur ro// oṃ badz+ra satwa twaṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa mi/ badz+ra nā ma a bhi ṣe ka taḥ kye dpal zhes bos nas gsang mtshan skyes pa la gti mug rdo rje/ sgyu 'phrul rdo rje/ rtag pa'i rdo rje/ zhe sdang rdo rje/ thugs kyi rdo rje/ nga rgyal rdo rje/ rdo rje nam mkha'/ 'dod chags rdo rje/ gsung gi rdo rje/ phrag dog rdo rje/ dam tshig rdo rje rnams gang rung*/ bud med la rdo rje spyan ma/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro/ rdo rje dbang bskur ma/ rdo rje bzhad ma/ rdo rje sgrol ma rnams gang rung btags/ su ra te s+t+waṃ a haṃ zhes/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi sogs kyis bum chu sbyin/ chu lhag ma yar lud pa las spyi gtsug tu rnam par snang mdzad yab yum gyis dbu brgyan pa sogs sngar ltar bya/ des rnam par snang mdzad gshin rje'i gshed ming gi dbang bskur ba thob/ gti mug gi= gzugs kyi= chos kyi dbyings kyi= rnam par snang mdzad kyi= sku'i byin rlabs= de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi dngos grub dang phrin las bsgrub pa la dbang ngo*// zhes sbyar zhing go ba bskyed/

de rnams rigs dbang lnga po la rgyas par na/ slob dpon dang*/ dbang rdzas dang*/ slob ma gsum ga dbang rang rang gi lhar yan lag bzhi rdzogs kyis bskyed dgos la/ bsdu na slob dpon gtso bo'i nga rgyal las go ma 'phos par slob ma dang dam rdzas so sor skabs thob tu go 'pho ba dkyus ltar bya zhing*/ lar ni slob dpon dang slob ma dbang rdzas gsum ga lhar bskyed pa mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor pa rnams dang nam mkhar spyan drangs pa'i dbang lha rnams gdan gsum don gyis tshang ba la tshang bar go zhing shes pa'i nges pa rnyed pa ni dpon slob gnyis ka'i bsam 'dun gal shin tu che ba'i phyir ro// de rnams ni ma rig pa sogs nyon mongs pa lnga rig pa ye shes su gnas bsgyur bas rig pa'i dbang zhes bya'o// zhes bshad/ skabs 'dir de'i mtha' rten brtul zhugs sbyin pa la rdo rje'i brtul zhugs/ rig ma'i brtul zhugs/ spyod pa'i brtul zhugs sogs mang du bshad kyang gtso bor gyur pa rdo rje'i brtul zhugs sbyin pa ni/ slob ma pad zla'i steng du hūm̐ dang rdo rje las rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog dkar po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa dar dang rin po ches brgyan cing g.yon brkyang gis bzhengs par bskyed la/ slob dpon gyis rdo rje rtse lnga pa de'i lag g.yas su gtad la/ 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad nyid// rdo rje sems dpa'i phyag na gnas// khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bzung*| |phyag na rdo rje'i brtul zhugs brtan// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sid+dhi badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha e ṣa s+t+waṃ dha ra yā mi badz+ra satwa hiḥ hi hi hi hi hūm̐/ zhes gtad/ des kyang sngags 'di brjod cing rdo rje smin mtshams su gsor zhing snying gar bzung ba la slob dpon gyis/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dngos grub tu nges par bya ste rdo rje yongs su mi 'dor ba'o// zhes brjod/ de nas/ slob mas dbang de rnams kyi sdom pa thob tshul brjod pa ni/

dkyil 'khor gyi 'jug pa phyi nang gis lha rnams dang skal pa mnyam par byas la/ rigs dbang lngas nyon mongs lnga phung po lnga 'byung ba lnga sogs kyi dri ma sbyangs nas| bde gshegs lnga dang ye shes lngar byin gyis brlabs pas rigs lnga spyi dang bye brag tu bcas pa'i sdom pa rnams thob/ rdo rje'i brtul zhugs kyis tha mal gyi rnam rtog spangs shing drug pa rdo rje 'chang gis byin gyis rlob pas na/ rigs drug dang lnga dang gsum sogs gsang chen rigs gcig tu bsdus pa ste/ des na dbang 'di rnams kyis bya spyod kyi rgyud rnams sgom sgrub nyan bshad byed pa la dbang ba yin no// zhes brjod/ gtang rag gi maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ gnyis pa slob dpon gyi dbang la bzhi/ bum pa/ gsang ba/ shes rab/ bzhi pa rnams so// dang po maṇ+ḍal phul nas/ mi ldog 'khor lo'i dbang bskur ba// mgon pos bdag la bstsal nas kyang*// 'khor lo lha yi de nyid dang*// slob dpon phrin las yongs su gsungs// sangs rgyas kun gyi dam tshig dang*// sdom pa'ang bla med gsung du gsol| |zhes gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ dbang stegs dbus rdo rje dang*/ g.yas g.yon seng ges bteg pa'i steng du 'khor lo rtsibs bcu gnyis pa'i lte bar sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i gdan la/ hūm̐ las skyes pa'i rdo rje 'chang gshin rje'i gshed sku mdog nag po/ g.yas rdo rje dang g.yon dril bu 'dzin pa/ dpal gyi chas brgyad kyis brgyan pa/ g.yon brkyang gis bsgyings par gsal ba la rdo rje rtse lnga pa g.yas su gtad la/ rdo rje hūm̐ las byung ba'i rdo rje sems dpa' de zhu ba las byung ba'i rdo rjer mos/ thog mtha' med pa'i sems dpa' ni// rdo rje sems dpa' dga' ba che// kun tu bzang po kun bdag nyid// rdo rje snyems ma'i bdag po'i bdag /bcom ldan 'das dpal mchog gi dang po'i skyes bu'o// oṃ ma hā badz+ra hūm̐/ zhes brjod cing*/

sngags de slob mas kyang brjod pa ni thugs rdo rje'i dam tshig go// dril bu aḥlas rdo rje snyems ma de zhu ba las byung ba'i dril bur mos pa g.yon du gtad la/ 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// shes rab dbyangs kyi rjes 'gror bshad| khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcang*// byang chub mchog tu rgyal bas bzhed// ces gtad pa slob mas dku g.yon du bzung nas/ srid pa ngo bo nyid kyis dag /ngo bo nyid kyis srid bral byas// rang bzhin dag pa'i sems ldan pa// dam pa'i srid pa byed par 'gyur// oṃ badz+ra ghaṇ+ṭa aḥ zhes slob mas brjod cing dril bu dkrol ba ni/ gsung dril bu'i dam tshig go// de nas phyag rgya ni/ yid ni lus ni brtan pa nyid// phyag rgya'i dam tshig rab tu brjod// gang gi lus ni thams cad brtan// des na phyag rgyar rab tu grags// ye shes phyag rgyar byin brlabs nas// 'dod pa thams cad longs spyad pas// dngos grub thams cad bsgrub par bya// zhes ye shes kyi phyag rgya lo bcu drug ma slob mar gtad la/ phyag rgya de yum rdo rje snyems ma sngon mo gri thod 'dzin pa rus pa dang rin po che'i brgyan par gsal ba dang*/ slob ma rdor sems su gsal ba gnyis kha sbyor gyi rim pas byin gyis brlabs te/ slob ma rdor dril dang bcas 'khyud pa'i tshul byed du bcug pa la/ bla mas/ shes rab bcu drug lon pa la// lag pa dag gis yang dag 'khyud// rdo rje dril bu mnyam sbyor ba// slob dpon gyi ni dbang du 'dod// ces pa dang*/ rdo rje che dang dril bu che// zung zhig rdo rjer byin gyis brlabs// de ring rdo rje slob dpon gyur// slob ma'i tshogs kun bsdu bar gyis// de ltar 'khyud pa las byung ba'i bde 'di ni rlung gi rig bde mnyam sbyor ma gtogs thig le mnyam sbyor min te/ yin na'ang sher dbang du 'gyur ba'i phyir ro// stong gnyis med kyi ye shes rang rig pa ni slob dpon gyi dbang ngam bum pa'i dbang gi dngos gzhi yin la/

sngags sdom gyi rtsa ba ni rdzogs rim yin pas de bskyed pa la/ bum dbang gi rten phung khams skye mched thams cad lhar bsgyur ba dgos pas zhing sa gshin po dang 'dra bar byas pa yin no// zhes go ba bskyed pa ni sku phyag rgya'i dam tshig go// de nyid brtan byed chu dbang ni/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba 'khor dang bcas pa dbang gi lha rigs lnga yab yum sems dpa' sems ma khro bo dang khro mo'i tshogs kyi rnam par spyan drangs/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+paṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ de bzhin/ dhū paṃ/ ā lo kaṃ/ gan+dhe| nai wi d+ye/ sbyar bas mchod/ rdo rje can gyis sangs rgyas la// 'gro ba skyob ba'i ched du dbang*// yon tan 'byung gnas ji ltar bstsal// de ltar 'di la'ang bstsal du gsol// zhes slob dpon gyis gsol ba btab pas/ nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i dbang gi lha dang lha mo rnams kyis gdugs dang rgyal mtshan dang*/ ba dan/ na bza' rnams slob ma'i steng phyogs su 'dzin glu dang gar mdzad cing rol mo'i sgra sgrog /me tog dang gur gum la sogs pa'i char 'bebs/ khro bo rnams kyis bgegs srung*/ rig ma rnams kyis bkra shis kyi glu len/ dbang gi lhas phyag gis cung zad yo bar bzung ba'i bum pa dkar po byang chub sems kyi bdud rtsis bkang ba bsnams nas/ slob ma la dbang bskur bar bsam/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs dang*/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ zhes bum pas dbang bskur/ bum chu sbyin/ de ltar bum pa'i chus dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag /chu'i lhag ma las mi bskyod pa yab yum gyis dbu brgyan/ nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i dbang gi lha rnams ye shes sems dpa'i ngo bor slob ma bcug /oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swā hā/ zhes me tog 'thor/ puṣ+pe sogs nyer spyod lngas mchod/ de ltar khyod la rdo rje 'chang gshin rje'i gshed chen po'i dbang bskur ba 'di nyid phung po dang*/

khams dang*/ skye mched kyi dri ma dag par byas pas de thams cad rang rig sems nyid tsam du 'dus la/ sems de nyid bcom ldan 'das gshin rje'i gshed yin cing*/ de'i rang bzhin dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la sogs pa'ang gshin rje'i gshed de de bas na rang gi sems rnam par dag pa nyid dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo yin te/ ji skad du/ dkyil 'khor zhes ni gang bshad pa// yid ni dkyil 'khor dam pa yin// zhes gsungs pas/ rang gi sems nyid ni rten gyi dkyil 'khor yin la/ sems de nyid la phung khams skye mched sogs su snang ba ni gdan gsum tshang ba'i lha yin te/ ji skad du/ mdor na phung po lnga rgyal ba// de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad yin// rdo rje'i skye mched nyid dag kyang*// byang chub sems dpa'i dkyil 'khor mchog /sa ni spyan zhes bya ba ste// chu yi khams ni mā ma kī// dkar dang sgrol ma zhes bya gang*// me dang rlung dang rab tu grags| |zhes pas/ rnam pa mtshon byed dpe'i dkyil 'khor thams cad kyang don rang gi gti mug dag pa chos dbyings ye shes phyag rgya zil gnon/ 'dod chags dag pa sor rtog ye shes yum ma mo khrag mig ma/ nga rgyal dag pa mnyam nyid ye shes sras ya ma rā tsa/ zhe sdang dag pa me long ye shes sku sprul 'chi bdag /phrag dog dag pa bya grub ye shes gsung sprul srog bdag /de dag gi rang rtsal rang mdangs nyi ma la 'od zer ltar snang ba ni bsrung ba'i gur khang la sogs pa rnams so// gzhan yang rang gi phung po lnga rgyal ba lnga/ 'byung ba lnga yum lnga/ mig sogs nang gi skye mched sems dpa' drug /gzugs sogs phyi'i skye mched sems ma drug /nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa zad par byed pa sogs dang dam tshig rtsa rnams khro bo dang khro mo ste gdan gsum tshang ba/ de yang rten dang brten pa thams cad tha dad pa ma yin par gtso bo gcig pu'i zab gsal gnyis med kyi ye shes kyi rol pa las ma 'das shing*/

gtso 'khor thams cad kyang rgyud tha dad ma yin te gtso bo'i rang rtsal kho na yin la/ mdor na 'khor 'das kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad kyang gtso bo kho na'i chos kyi dbyings mnyam pa chen po'i rol pa nyid yin la/ de'ang rang gi sems nyid gdod nas 'od gsal bde ba chen por snang bas snang phyogs rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor la/ de dag kyang stong phyogs blo las 'das pas 'dzin pa med pa rtag chad kyi mtha' dang bral ba gdod nas yongs su grub pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo yin pa la yin par ngo shes pa gyis shig /ces dag pa brjod/ des khyod kyis rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang thob pa yin pas dkyil 'khor bri zhing sgrub pa dang*/ 'jug cing dbang bskur ba dang*/ rab tu gnas pa dang*/ sbyin sreg la sogs pa/ mdor na phyi nang gsang ba'i de nyid bcus bsdus pa'i rdo rje slob dpon gyi las dang bya ba'i rim pa 'khor dang bcas pa la dbang ba yin no// zhes gnang ba sbyin/ 'di'i mtha' rten pha rgyud du gsungs pa ni/ thor tshugs dbu rgyan dang bcas pa la/ oṃ a kro te ka ya mān+ta ka hūm̐ phaṭ| ces lan gsum bzlas la/ rdo rje sems dpa'i phyag rgya 'di// phyi dang nang du yang dag gnas// gzugs ni thor tshugs dbu rgyan 'chang*// byin pa dpa' bos bzung bar gyis// zhes brjod la 'dzin du gzhug go// des mtshan bcas phyi'i dkyil 'khor la brten nas bum pa'i dbang bskur ba thob/ gtso bor thun mong ba lus kyi las gsum dang*/ sad pa'i gnas skabs kyi sgrib pa sngar bsags pa rnams sbyong zhing phyi ma rnams sdom/ thun mong ma yin pa lus tha mal du 'dzin pa'i snang zhen gyi dri ma 'khrud/ lam ting nge 'dzin gsum dang bskyed pa'i rim pa 'khor bcas bsgom zhing*| bsnyen pa'i yan lag dang*/ phrin las bzhi dang*/ grub chen brgyad sogs sgrub pa dang*/ rtsa ltung bcu bzhi yan lag brgyad de dam tshig nyer gnyis bsrung ba la dbang*/

sprul sku'i nus pa khyad par can 'jog go// 'bras bu sku rdo rje thob pa'i skal pa dang ldan par byas so// zhes rtogs pa brjod/ dbang bzhi so sor rtogs pa bskyed pa rgyas par spro na/ bshags pa thams cad kyi rgyud dri ma med pa'i rgyal po gnyags dzñā na ku mā ra'i 'gyur las/ rnam grangs bco lnga bco lngas brjod de bum dbang la/ phyi sgro 'dogs yongs su gcod pa'i bla mas rdul tshon dbyibs kyi dkyil 'khor du bum pa'i dbang bskur nas/ gtso bo lus rtsa'i dri ma dag /des zhing sa gshin po dang 'dra/ yon tan brgya phrag bdun dang bye ba phrag bdun sogs la dbang 'byor/ lam bskyed pa'i rim pa bsgom pa la dbang*/ dbyibs kyi rnal 'byor/ mchan/ lta ba ngo bo nyid gsum/ snang phyogs ngo bo nyid de bzhin stong phyogs zung 'jug dang*/ mchan/ 'da' ka ma gong du 'pho ba bar dor dbang dag sems ro gcig pa/ snang ba bsgyur ba dang 'od kyi gong bu dang 'dra ba'i 'pho ba dang gsum/ mchan/ dam tshig nyi shu rtsa gnyis bsrungs/ brda lnga bsdus te rtse mos mnan pa/ grub mtha' 'khor 'das dbyer med/ snod bcud lhar shes pa 'dis sa drug pa man bgrod nus/ mchan/ rtsa'i 'gros mchog tu thim pas/ 'bras bu sprul pa'i sku rang bzhin lhun grub kyi rten 'brel mngon du byas so// zhes sbyar/ de ltar bum dbang thob pa'i mnyam bzhag gi dam tshig bskyed rim bsgom/ rjes thob kyi dam tshig lha dang mi 'bral zhing lus ngag yid gsum tha mal du ma 'khrul ba/ bza' ba'i dam tshig sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga la rol ba/ bcang ba'i dam tshig rdo rje dril bu dang mi 'bral ba/ bsrung ba'i dam tshig snod bcud thams cad gzhal yas khang dang lhar shes pa rnams dang mi 'bral bar bya'o// zhes dam bsgrags/ gtang rag dbul/ gnyis pa gsang ba'i dbang la maṇ+ḍal phul/ khyod kyi zhabs kyi bka' drin gyis// bdag gis bla med bya ba thob// de phyir gsang ba'i dbang gis ni/

mgon pos rjes su gzung bar mdzod// gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ slob ma'i gdong bcings la/ rdo rje slob dpon phyag rgya mtshan ldan dang 'du shes gsum gyis snyoms 'jug bya zhing*/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ṇa badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes pas rang gi snying ga'i 'od kyis rgyal ba yab yum rnams snyoms par 'jug pa bkug pa rnam snang gi sgo nas bdag nyid la bcug pas chags pa chen pos byang chub kyi sems su zhu ba dhū ti nas 'ong*/ dga' ba la sogs pa'i rim gyis mkha' gsang du bab pas yab yum gyi dkar dmar 'dres pa byung ste/ thod pa'i bdud rtsir sbyar ba slob ma skad cig gis gsung rdo rje 'dod chags gshin rje'i gshed sku mdog dmar po/ pad+ma dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ rus pa dang rin po ches brgyan par bskyed pa'i khar sbyin zhing*/ byang chub sems ni rin chen 'bar phyung bas// ma lus rgyal ba rnams ni lus bskams la| |rnam dag rdo rje las byung ye shes chu// dri med rin chen spyi nas dbang bskur ro// zhes dang*/ btung ba rin chen 'di yis ni// rdo rje yi ni lus 'grub par// bu khyod kyis ni shes gyis la| |yid las byung ba'i chu 'thung zhig /oṃ ya ma rā dza bo dhi tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes sbyin/ slob mas kyang rgyal ba 'khor bcas zhu ba'i dbang rdzas su bsams la/ a hoḥm hā su khaṃ/ zhes brjod la myang*/ de yang slob ma'i mgrin par ya ra la wa rtsa mdud kyi rnam par yod pa'i nang du khams gnas pa de bla ma yab yum gyi byang sems de nyid ye shes pa'i tshul du 'dres ma thag byang sems 'phel nas/ lus thams cad la khyab tshe bde ba skyes pa ni sa bon btab pa dang 'dra'o// de ltar bla ma yab yum gyi byang sems lce thog tu bzhag pa myangs shing*/ bha ga la bltas pa las skyes pa'i dga' ba dang bcas pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi ye shes skye ba ni/ byang sems dkar po mgrin pa'i rtsa 'khor nas brgyud de lus kyi rtsa gnas thams cad du khyab pas bde ba dang*/

byang sems dmar po bkram pas me lta bu'i drod skyes te/ 'bar 'dzag gi rkyen gyis zhu bde lhan skyes thig le gsum gyi ye shes bde drod zung 'jug gi rtogs pa rang bzhin brgyad cu'i rnam rtog dbyings su dag pa de nyid gsang dbang gi ngo bo yin no// zhes go ba bskyed/ mig dar bsal/ de'i mtha' rten lung bstan bya ba ni/ slob dpon shākya thub pa'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas langs la/ snam sbyar gyon pa'i lag g.yon pas de'i grwa gnyis ri dwags kyi rna ba ltar nu ma g.yon pa'i thad du rdo rje khu tshur kha gyen bstan gyis bzung*/ g.yas rdor dril dang bcas mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya slob ma me tog phog pa'i lhar bskyed pa'i spyi bor bzhag la/ oṃ/ 'dir ni khyod la ngas lung bstan// rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs// srid pa shin tu dag pa'i phyir// srid dang ngan 'gro rnams las bton// kyai dpal zhes dang*/ sngar gsang mtshan gang btags pa brjod la/ zhes bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa grub pas sa gsum gyi bdag por 'gyur ro// 'di brjod tshe mi 'jigs pa'i phyag rgyar bsgyur nas lag g.yas steng du brkyangs la dril bu gsil zhing*/ gang ngas tshig 'dis lung bstan pa de la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' 'khor dang bcas pa mgrin gcig tu byang chub chen por lung ston par mdzad de/ phyag rgya dang sngags 'di nyid kyi mthu las yin no// zhes bsgrags/ nyer spyod lngas mchod/ des ni bha ga'i dkyil 'khor la brten nas gsang ba'i dbang bskur ba thob/ gtso 'khor thun mong ba ngag gi las bzhi dang rmi lam gyi gnas skabs kyi dri ma sngar bsags rnams sbyong zhing phyi ma rnams sdom/ thun mong ma yin pa las rlung gi dri ma 'khrud/ lam rdo rje'i bzlas pa dang*/ sgyu lus dang*/ rang byin rlabs dang*/ tsaṇ+ḍa lī steng sgo rnam par grol ba'i lam gyi rtsa rlung thig le'i rnal 'byor rnams dang rlung gi sbyor bas las sgrub pa dang*/

nye bar bsgrub pa'i yan lag bsgom pa la dbang*/ longs sku'i nus pa khyad par can 'jog /'bras bu gsung rdo rje thob pa'i skal pa dang ldan par byas so// zhes rtogs pa brjod/ gsang dbang la rang byung gi ye shes ston pa'i bla mas/ bha ga'i dkyil 'khor du/ gsang ba'i dbang bskur bas/ gtso bor ngag gi dri ma dag /des zhing sa gshin po la sa bon btab pa dang*/ yon tan nus pa lnga la dbang 'byor zhing lta stangs la thogs pa med pa dang tshig gi mchog 'grub cing so so yang dag rig pa bzhi la dbang thob/ lam rang byin rlabs bsgom pa la dbang*/ lta ba rang byung gi ye shes/ nyon mongs rang byung ye shes de bzhin du rnam rtog dang sbrel zhing gsal zhing yangs pa dang bzhi/ mchan/ 'da' ka ma 'od gsal 'chi ba 'od gsal gyi 'pho ba/ mchan/ bar dor rang byung ye shes gsal la rtog med dam tshig sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga bsten/ brda mtheb srin e ma rig byed gcig /grub mtha' sa bcu'i sar bgrod nus/ mchan/ ma 'dres la yongs su rdzogs pa/ yi ge'i 'gros mchog tu thim/ 'bras bu longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku rang bzhin lhun grub kyi rten 'brel mngon du byas so// zhes sbyar/ de ltar gsang dbang thob pa'i mnyam gzhag gi dam tshig gtum mo tsaṇ+ḍa lī bsgom/ rjes thob kyi dam tshig a thung ye shes kyi me sbar ba/ bza' ba'i dam tshig ye shes kyi bdud rtsir byin gyis brlabs nas rol pa| bcang ba'i dam tshig rlung kha sbyor nyer gcig re bsgom pa/ bsrung ba'i dam tshig dgos pa gal che na ma gtogs byang chub kyi sems ma nyams par bsrung ba rnams so// zhes bsgrags/ gtang rag dbul/ gsum pa sher dbang la maṇ+ḍal 'bul zhing*/ slob mas/ bcom ldan zhi ba chen po kyai// rdo rje rnal 'byor gcig bzhed pa// mi phyed phyag rgya sgrub pa po// rdo rje sbyor las yang dag byung*// ji ltar khyod ni bdag nyid che// mnga' bdag bdag la'ang de ltar mdzod// 'khor ba 'dam gyi tshogs nang du// bying ba skyabs med bdag la skyobs// zhes gsum gyis gsol ba btab/

slob ma'i gdong bcings la/ gsang dbang gi rten rig ma de'am/ gzhan yang rung ba mtshan nyid dam sdom dang ldan pa'i lag g.yon dang*/ slob ma'i lag g.yas nas slob dpon gyi lag g.yon pas bzung g.yas pas slob ma'i spyi bor rdo rje bzhag la/ 'dir ni khyod rnams dpang po yin// bdag gis 'di la 'di gtad do// zhes dkyil 'khor pa rnams dpang por byas nas slob mar/ gzung ma yid 'ong 'di khyod kyis// bsten byar sangs rgyas rnams kyis bshad// 'khor lo rim pa'i sbyor ba yis/ */bde ba dam pa myong bar gyis// rdo rje'i skyil krung gis sems ni// nor bu nang du chud par blta// zhes rig ma gtad/ rig mas kyang slob mar/ bshang gci dag ni za ba dang*/ */ khrag dang khu ba de bzhin te// sha chen bsten par bu spro 'am// bha ga'i pad+mor 'o byed pa// bu khyod ji ltar dga' ba smros// zhes smras pa la/ rig mas bha ga bstan nas/ e ma bdag gi pad+ma 'di// bde ba kun dang yang dag ldan// ci ste cho ga bzhin bsten na// de yi mdun na bdag gnas te// sangs rgyas bsnyen pa la sogs pa'i// bya ba thams cad pad+mas byed// bde chen rgyal po rang nyid ni// 'di nyid du ni yang dag gnas// bhañdza mok+ṣa hoḥ zhes gsung zhing slob ma'i pang du byon par bsam/ de nas/ slob ma gtso bo dang rig ma de'i yum bskyed pa sprul skur byin gyis brlabs/ hrīḥdang hūm̐ yig las skyes pa'i pad+ma dang rdo rje āḥdang oṃ yig gis ze'u 'bru dang nor bur mtshan pa'i rdo rje'i kha la phaṭa ser po dang bcas pa sems ma mkha' gsang bsnol mar byin gyis brlabs pa ni longs skur byin gyis brlabs pa/ thabs 'di la brten nas lhan skyes kyi ye shes mngon du bya'o snyam du bsam pa chos skur byin gyis brlabs pa ste/ sku gsum thob phyir 'du shes gsum dang ldan pas rig ma'i g.yon gyi char son pa'i rtsa rdo rje dbyings phyug ma mdzub mo dang lce rtse hrīḥdamar po bsams te ye shes sngon du 'gro bas yang dag par bskul zhing rnyed pa na snyoms par zhugs la/

oṃ shī shī shī ha ha ha swā hā/ zhes dang*/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ṇa badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes pa'i sngags slob mas brjod cing*/ yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i tshe byang sems spyi bo nas mgrin par bab pa dga' ba/ mgrin pa nas snying gar mchog dga'/ snying ga nas lte bar dga' bral/ lte ba nas nor bu'i rtse mor son pa lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' ba/ der rlung gi gnad kyis 'pho med du bcings te gyen du ldog pa na lte bar dga' ba/ snying gar mchog dga'/ mgrin par dga' bral/ spyi bor lhan cig skyes dgar shes par bya la/ de'i tshe slob ma rang gi snying ga'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis de bzhin gshegs pa yum dang bcas pa rnams spyan drangs te kha nas zhugs te thim par dmigs pas lus byin gyis brlabs la/ bla mas kyang rnam snang dang spyan ma la sogs pa dpag tu med pa rnams slob ma yab yum gyi lus la bcug pa dang ro gcig tu gyur par bsams nas/ dga' ba brtsi zhing de'i tshe nus pa ji lta bar 'dzin cing ma zin na dal bus btang nas chu skyes las lces blangs te/ de kho na nyid kyi bsam pas dam tshig gi ngo bo byang chub kyi sems btung bar bya ba sogs man ngag ltar bya'o// sher dbang gi phyag rgya'i snyoms 'jug la brten nas sngar gyi byang sems de nyid gtsug tor nor bu'i rtse mo'i bar yas bab kyi dga' ba bzhi nyams su myong ba ni myu gu 'khrungs pa dang 'dra'o zhes dang*/ de ltar 'du shes gsum ldan gyis rig ma la snyoms par zhugs pa'i tshe byang sems nor bur bab pa 'pho med du bcings pa'i tshe/ skyes pa'i dga' ba bzhi'i tha ma'i tshe snang mched thob gsum gyi mthar 'od gsal dpe'i lhan skyes kun rdzob yin yang bzhi pa don dam pa mtshon byed du gyur pa 'di ni dbang gsum pa'i ngo bo yin no// zhes go ba bskyed/ mig dar bsal/ de'i mtha' rten dbugs dbyung ni/

lha thams cad kyi snying po'i sngags kyis btab pa'i srung skud lag pa g.yas par bcings| de'i spyi bor gdugs bzung ba dkyil 'khor la skor ba byas nas slob mas dkyil 'khor gyi shar sgor phyag btsal thal mo sbyar nas 'dug la/ bla mas/ rgyud rnams 'dzin par gyur pa yi// slob ma 'di ni phul ba lags// zhes pas dkyil 'khor dbang phyug la gsol ba btab la 'dug /gzhan du bzhag nas slar bla mas slob ma'i snying la bab pa'i tshig 'di dag brjod de/ da ni khyod rnams dkyil 'khor gyi// slob dpon sngags dang rgyud 'dzin par// sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang*// lha rnams dag kyang dgongs par 'gyur// sems can kun la brtse don du// khyod kyis dkyil 'khor cho ga bzhin// rab tu 'bad de bri bar bya// sgrub pa po rnams rgyud la sbyor// mchog tu gsang ba dam pa yi// dkyil 'khor mthong zhing zhugs pas na// sdig pa kun las rnam par grol// de ring khyod rnams bde bar gnas// bde chen theg pa 'di la ni// phyin chad 'chi ba khyod la med// srid pa'i sdug bsngal las khyod 'das// srid pa shin tu mtha' grub pa// sangs rgyas rdo rje can kun gyis// de ring tshe ldan dbang bskur ro| |khams gsum kun gyi rgyal srid che'i// bdag po nyid du khyod nges so// 'dod chags bral ba lta bu'i sdig /khams gsum na ni gzhan med de// de bas 'dod la chags bral ba// khyod kyis nam yang mi bya'o// 'dod pa kun la spyod pa khyod// gang la'ang 'jigs med spyod par gyis// sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga bza' bya// 'di las gzhan yang dam tshig srungs// srog chags bsad par mi bya zhing*// bud med rin chen spang mi bya// slob dpon spang bar mi bya ste// dam tshig shin tu 'da' bar dka'// shes rab thabs kyi bsam pa yi// mi bya cung zad yod ma yin| |ma 'jigs khyod la sdig pa med// de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsung ji bzhin// 'di ltar yid ni rab dang rdo rje nyid du bgyis// rang gi dam tshig mi zad bde ster bsten par gyis// 'gro ba bde ba nyung las rdo rje sems dpa' dang*// mtshungs med rtag pa nyid du khyod rnams phyin par 'gyur// gzhan yang gang dag cho ga ji lta ba bzhin du dbang bskur ba la dge ba'i phyir sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis sdug pa'i bu dang 'dra bar thugs dang bas yang dag par dgongs par mdzad pa 'di ni chos nyid yin no// zhes brjod/

nyer spyod lngas mchod/ des gsang ba kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor la brten nas shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur ba thob/ gtso bo thun mong ba yid kyi las gsum dang gnyid mthug gi gnas skabs kyi dri ma sngar bsags pa rnams sbyong zhing phyi ma rnams sdom/ thun mong ma yin pa gzung 'dzin gyi rnam rtog rags pa'i dri ma 'khrud/ lam gzung 'dzin gyis stong pa'i 'od gsal lam rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin dang 'og sgo bde ba chen po'i pho nya mo rigs lnga bsten pa dang bsgrub pa'i yan lag bsgom pa la dbang*/ chos sku'i nus pa khyad par can 'jog go// 'bras bu thugs rdo rje thob pa'i skal pa dang ldan par byas so// zhes rtogs pa bskyed/ sher dbang la/ gsang ba lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes ston pa'i bla mas/ kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur bas/ gtso bo yid kyi dri ma dag /des sa bon la myu gu smin pa dang 'dra/ yon tan sku gsum ye shes lnga la sogs pa sangs rgyas kyi yon tan ci rigs pa la dbang 'byor/ lam dkyil 'khor 'khor lo bsgom pa la dbang*/ lta ba yas bab kyi dga' ba bzhi/ dga' ba la mchog dga' dga' bral lhan skyes/ mchan/ 'da' ka ma'am 'chi ba'i tshe rdo rje sems dpa' 'byon par 'gyur ba/ rdor sems dang mjal te 'pho ba/ mchan/ bar dor lhan skyes kyi bde ba/ dam tshig bud med la mi smod/ brda byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya grub mtha' bde stong rgya chung ngu*/ sa bcu gnyis pa phyin bgrod/ mchan/ bdud rtsi'i 'gros mchog du thim mo// 'bras bu chos kyi sku rang bzhin lhun grub kyi rten 'brel mngon du bya'o// zhes sbyar/ de ltar shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob pa'i mnyam bzhag gi dam tshig dngos sam yid kyis rig ma bsten pa/ rjes thob kyi dam tshig bde chen gyi nyams dang mi 'bral bar byed pa/

bza' ba'i dam tshig snyoms 'jug gi tshul du rol ba/ bcang ba'i dam tshig byang sems gnyis rtag par bsrung ba/ bsrung ba'i dam tshig rig ma mtshan ldan bsten zhing bud med la mi smod pa rnams so// zhes bsgrags/ gtang rag 'bul/ bzhi pa tshig dbang la maṇ+ḍal phul nas slob mas/ bdag nyid che khyod bka' drin gyis// gtso bo'i dbang bskur rnam gsum thob// de ring rin chen bzhi pa yang*// bka' drin gyis ni bskyang du gsol// gsum gyis gsol ba btab| gdong bcings la/ slob ma lus rnam snang gi chos bdun ldan/ sems dus gsum gyi rtog pa'i rgyu ba bcad de zab cing rgya che ba'i rtogs pa bskyed du bcug pa la/ slob dpon gyis/ ye shes 'di ni ches phra zhing*// rdo rje snying po mkha' dang mtshungs// rdul bral mtha' ster zhi ba nyid// khyod rang yang ni de yi pha// zhes pa ni dbang bzhi pa'i ngo bo nyid yin la/ de'ang shes rab ye shes kyi dpe'i lhan skyes de nyid dbang bzhi pa don gyi lhan skyes 'bras bu'i myu gu lta bu yin la/ de lta bu'i byang chub kyi sems de nyid bsgoms pas goms par byas nas gong nas gong du rab tu 'phel bzhin pa sgrib pa thams cad zad pas med pa nyid du gyur pa'i de kho na nyid chos thams cad bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rang bzhin 'od gsal chos kyi sku yan lag bdun ldan gyi ngo bo lha sku phyag rgya chen po longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku'i bdag nyid can zung 'jug 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed don dam pa gang yin pa de ni dbang bzhi pa'i ye shes yin zhing*/ de'i don ni dbang bzhi'i lam la brten nas nyams su myong ba'i lhan skyes kyi ye shes 'di ni yod min med min gyi mtha' bzhi las 'das pa/ snang stong*/ bde stong*/ gsal stong zung du 'jug pa 'khor 'das thams cad kyi bdag nyid yin la/ de ni blo yin yang yul dang gnyis su med pas zab cing rtogs dka' bas na ches phra zhing*/

mi chod pa dang*/ mi shigs pa'i sems yin pas na rdo rje/ chos thams cad 'byung bas snying po/ gang du'ang ma grub pas nam mkha' dang mtshungs la/ rnam par mi rtog pas na rdul bral/ mya ngan las 'das pas mtha' ster/ spros pa dang bral bas zhi ba nyid do// khyod rang sogs ni de khyod la ji ltar slob dpon gyis brda sprad cing bsgoms pas rang byung lhun grub tu mngon du 'gyur la/ de chos sku yin pa'i phyir gzhan du btsal bas ci bya ste/ sangs rgyas gzhan nas rnyed pa min no zhes pa'i don yin la/ de yang rang byung zhes pa ni/ rang las rang byung ba min gyi glo bur ba'i rkyen la mi ltos par thog mtha' med pa'i byang chub kyi sems rgyun chags su 'byung ba de nyid bla ma'i byin rlabs kyis cung zad mngon du gyur pa ste chu la chu bzhag ltar gzhi rtog med la/ lam yang rtog med du bzhag pas ches phra nas zhi ba'i bar mngon du gyur pa'i don yin la/ sher dbang gi dpe'i ye shes de nyid 'dir tshig tsam gyi sgo nas 'bras bu sangs rgyas kyi ye shes gnas lugs ngo sprad pas sngar gyi ye shes de'i thob bya mthar thug ngo 'phrod pas 'bras bu ston thog smin pa dang 'dra ba yin no// zhes dang*/ mig dar bsal nas/ de ring khyod la dga' bzhi'i ye shes bskyed cing nyams su myong bar byas kyi/ deng phyin chad lam skabs thams cad du nyams myong 'di sgom pa'i sgo nas mtshon bya don gyi bzhi pa mngon sum du 'gyur bar bya dgos te/ ji skad du/ ji srid byang chub snying po'i bar// kun tu rgyu bgyis rdo rje 'dzin// zhes gsungs pas/ nyams myong 'di nyid dus thams cad du lam du gyis shig /de ltar na mthar sa bcu gsum pa'i sa byed las khyod kyi bum dbang rtsa'i 'gros la sogs pa thim pas sku lnga mngon du 'gyur ro zhes pa ni 'bras bu'i bzhi pa'ang tshig tsam gyis bstan pa'o// zhes bsgrags/

de'i mtha' rten gzengs bstod ni/ slob dpon gyis mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya bstan la/ mchog tu gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dir// zhugs pa dang ni mthong bas kyang*// sdig pa kun las rnam grol nas// de ring khyod rnams bde bar gnas// bde chen theg pa 'di la ni// phyin chad 'chi ba yod min te// mi thub tshugs pa yod min pas| |cis kyang mi 'jigs dga' bar gyis// srid pa shin tu dga' ba'i phyir// srid pa'i sdug bsngal las khyod 'das// khyod rnams dkyil 'khor 'dir zhugs shing*// mthong ba'i phan yon las khyod rnams// srid pa shin tu dag pa yi/ byang chub tu gyur dga' bar gyis// sngar bshad pa'i dam tshig rnams tshul bzhin du srungs shig /ces gzengs bstod/ nyer spyod lngas mchod/ de dag gis de kho na nyid don dam byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bzhi pa thob/ gtso bo thun mong sgo gsum gyi dri ma bag chags dang bcas pa dang bzhi pa'i gnas skabs kyi dri ma sngar bsags pa rnams sbyong zhing phyi ma rnams sdom/ thun mong ma yin pa ye shes kyi dri ma gzung 'dzin gyi rnam rtog phra ba bag nyal dang bcas pa 'khrud/ lam 'od gsal dang zung 'jug phyag rgya chen po bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rim pa dang sgrub pa chen po'i yan lag bsgom pa la dbang*/ bde ba chen po'i sku'am ngo bo nyid kyi sku'i nus pa khyad par can 'jog /'bras bu ye shes rdo rje thob pa'i skal pa dang ldan par byas so// zhes go ba bskyed/ dbang bzhi pa la/ mthar thug de kho na nyid chos thams cad shin tu rnam par dag pa ston pa'i bla mas/ don dam byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bzhi pa tshig dbang rin po che bskur bas/ sgo gsum gyi dri ma bag chags dang bcas pa dag /des myu gu las lo tog phun sum tshogs pa 'byung ba dang 'dra/ yon tan sku gsung thugs mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo sangs rgyas kyi yon tan thams cad dbang 'byor/

lam rdo rje'i rba rlabs bsgom pa la dbang*/ lta ba mas brtan gyi dga' bzhi/ rgyu mthun rnam smin skyes bu byed pa dri ma med pa dang*/ mchan/ 'da' ka ma phyag rgya chen po nas 'pho ba/ 'pho bya 'pho byed dang bral ba/ mchan/ bar dor bde stong mchog gi ye shes/ dam tshig dgongs te gsungs pa mtha' dag |brda mdzub mos nam mkha' mtshon pa/ grub mtha' bde stong rgya chen po/ sa bcu gsum pa bgrod do// mchan/ rlung gi 'gros mchog tu thim pa/ 'bras bu ngo bo nyid kyi sku rang bzhin lhun grub kyi rten 'brel/ de ltar tshig dbang thob pas mnyam bzhag gi dam tshig zung 'jug gnyis med bsgom pa/ rjes thob kyi dam tshig de'i nyams dang mi 'bral zhing ngo bo bsgom pa/ bza' ba'i dam tshig chos nyid la chos nyid du rol ba/ bcang ba'i dam tshig dus rtag tu gnyis med kyi don la gnas par byed pa/ bsrung ba'i dam tshig gang shar ye shes lnga las mi 'da' bar bsgom pa rnams so// zhes dam bsgrags/ gtang rag 'bul lo// gnyis pa bye brag tu dbang bskur ba lnga/ sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las so// dang po lus lhar bsgyur ba lha rgyud kyi dbang la maṇ+ḍal phul nas/ slob mas/ hoḥ bstan pa'i sgron me bcom ldan 'das// rdo rje slob dpon dgongs su gsol// dregs pa'i stobs kyi tshul bstan pa// dregs pa'i lha tshogs dgongs su gsol// dam tshig bka' thub sdom pa'i mchog /rig pa'i rgyal po bdag la stsol// gsang ba'i sgron me bdag la stsol// ces gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ slob dpon gyis gtso bo'i sku slob ma'i mgor bzhag cing*/ mdun bskyed kyi gtso bo'i thugs ka nas rang 'dra ba'i gtso bo spros pa slob ma'i spyi bor thim par dpon slob gnyis kas bsams la/ hūm̐ */ bskal pa me ltar 'bar ba'i klong dkyil nas// gru gsum mthing nag e yi gzhal yas su// dpal chen khro rgyal 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed// srid gsum sgrol mdzad zhal gsum rngam pa'i stabs// rgyu drug sgrol mdzad phyag mtshan me tog 'bar// bdud bzhi 'dul phyir zhabs bzhis dregs pa brdzis// dur khrod chas ldan phyag rgya zil gyis gnon// gshin rje rol pa'i yongs rdzogs dbang bskur ro// oṃ mañdzu shrī ya mān+ta ka ma hā kro dha kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/

zhes bskur/ mkha' lding thogs nas/ mdun bskyed gtso bo'i spyi gtsug gi ye shes kyi bya khyung gi thugs ka nas rang 'dra ba spros te slob ma'i spyi bor thim par bsam zhing*/ hūm̐ */ rdo rje'i khyung nag 'jigs pa'i gzugs// klu dang sa bdag gza' la sogs// dregs pa ma rungs zas su za// ba spu rdo rje thog ser 'bebs// 'jigs byed gtum po'i dbang bskur ro// oṃ ya ma rā dza badz+ra ga ru ḍa kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ yum gyi sku thogs nas/ mdun bskyed gtso bo'i g.yon gyi yum ma mo khrag mig ma'i thugs ka nas rang 'dra ba spros slob ma la thim par bsam zhing*/ hūm̐ */ gnyis med sbyor ba'i yum chen ni// ma mo'i gtso mo khrag mig ma// gcer bu don snying khrag la rol// khams gsum sgrol mdzad dbang bskur ro// oṃ badz+ra be tā lī ma mo e ka dzā ti kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐// sras kyi sku thogs nas/ mdun bskyed gtso bo'i g.yas kyi sras mchog ya ma rā tsa'i thugs ka nas rang 'dra ba spros te slob mar thim par bsam zhing*/ hūm̐ */ thugs kyi phyag rgya rol pa las// sras mchog ya ma rā tsa ni// smug nag khros pa zhabs rdeb cing*// dgra bgegs gsod byed dbang bskur ro// oṃ ya ma rā tsa kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ sku sprul gyi sku thogs nas/ mdun bskyed gtso bo'i mdun gyi sku sprul 'chi bdag nag po'i thugs ka nas rang 'dra ba'i lha spros te slob mar thim par bsam zhing*/ hūm̐ */ sku yi phyag rgya rol pa las// bdud po bye ba dgu khri ni// mthing nag lcags chas chu glang bcibs// 'chi bdag 'bar bas dbang bskur ro// oṃ ya mān+ta ka ma ra ṇa pa ti kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ gsung sprul gyi sku thogs nas/ mdun bskyed gtso bo'i rgyab kyi gsung sprul srog bdag nag po'i thugs ka nas lha rang 'dra ba spros nas slob mar thim par bsam zhing*/ hūm̐ */

gsung gi phyag rgya rol pa las// sgrol ging ār+ya dmar po ni// dmar nag ru sbal g.yang gzhi gyon// rlung bcibs srog bdag dbang bskur ro// oṃ ya mān+ta ka prā ṇa pa ti kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes bskur/ de ltar lha yab yum sras gsum/ sprul pa gnyis/ mkha' lding dang bcas pa'i sku'i phyag rgya yongs su rdzogs pa'i dbang bskur bas/ gzung 'dzin gsum gyi mngon zhen gnyis snang gi dri ma dag nas/ lha'i sku bsgom pa la dbang zhing snod kyi 'jig rten gzhal yas khang du bcud kyi sems can lha'i skur rtogs par byas so// zhes go ba bskyed/ gtang rag 'bul/ gnyis pa ngag sngags su bsgyur ba snying po sngags kyi dbang bskur don du maṇ+ḍal phul nas/ slob mas/ sngags kyi dbang bskur ye shes che// dngos grub ster ba bdag la stsol// bcom ldan bdag gis gzung lags kyi// bdag la nye bar mdzad du gsol// gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ slob dpon gtso bor gsal ba'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las sngags kyi phreng ba byung ba zhal nas thon pa dang mdun bskyed kyi gtso bo'i thugs ka nas sngags kyi phreng ba byung ba zhal nas thon pa slob dpon gyi zhal gyi sngags phreng la thim/ de dag phyir phyung ba slob ma lhar gsal ba'i rna ba gnyis nas zhugs te snying ga'i sa bon la thim par dpon slob gnyis kas bsam nas/ yi ge bcu bdun pa gnyis dang*/ oṃ a kro te ka ya mān+ta ka ha na ma tha bhañdza hūm̐ phaṭ: ya ma me dak+ṣe rā tsa sa do ru ṇa yo ni ra ya tsa ni: oṃ a kro te ka ya mān+ta ka hūm̐ phaṭa: nyin bzhi ni/ ya ma rā dza sa do me ya: ya me do ru ṇa yo da ya: ya da yo ni ra ya k+ṣe ya: yak+ṣe ya tsa ni ra ma ya: bcu gcig pa dang nyin bzhi rnams tshar gsum gsum rjes bzlos bya/ slar slob dpon gyis rak+sha'i phreng ba'i phyed slob mar gtad phyed rang gis bzung nas/ hūm̐ */ rlung sngags dbyer med snying po'i sngags kyi sgra// gdul bya'i ngor snang grag stong ngo bo nyid// gsang sngags thugs bskul phrin las kun gyi gtso// ye shes rdo rje gsung gi dbang thob shog

/ces dang*/ yi ge bcu bdun pa gnyis dang*/ bcu gcig pa/ nyin bzhi rnams slob dpon gyis bzla zhing*/ slob mas dbyangs gsal rak+sha'i phreng ba la bgrang tshul bya/ slar slob dpon gyis/ bcom ldan 'di la bstsal lags kyi// 'di la 'go bar mdzad du gsol// sngags kyi dngos grub bstsal du gsol// phrin las rdzogs par mdzad du gsol// zhes dang*/ su pra tiṣ+ṭha brjod cing me tog dor/ de ltar dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo'i lha tshogs rnams kyi gsung snying po sngags kyi dbang bskur bas/ 'chal ba bden 'dzin gsum gyi dri ma dag nas sngags bzla ba la dbang zhing*/ sgrar grag stong thams cad gsung snying po grag stong sngags kyi rang sgrar rtogs par bya'o// zhes go ba bskyed/ gtang rag 'bul/ gsum pa sems ting nge 'dzin du bsgyur ba thugs phyag mtshan gyi dbang zhu ba'i phyir maṇ+ḍal dbul/ slob mas/ mtha' bral 'jigs med thugs kyi dngos// brdar btags phyag mtshan snang ngor shar// ting 'dzin rdo rje bsgrub pa'i phyir// ye shes dbang bskur bdag la stsol// gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ mdun bskyed gtso bo'i thugs ka nas thugs kyi ngo bo kun rdzob brdar btags pa'i phyag mtshan gyi rnam pa rnams spros pa slob ma'i snying gar thim par bsam la/ 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad/ ral gri/ rdo rje rtse dgu rnams lag g.yas su gtad la/ hūm̐ */ 'khor ba sgrol byed 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad 'bar// nyon mongs gcod pa'i ral gri rno ngar ldan// chos nyid don mtshon rdo rje rtse dgu pa// thugs mchog ye shes ting 'dzin dbang bskur ro// oṃ ya mān+ta ka tsakra khaḍ+ga badz+ra tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ lcags kyu/ gtun shing*/ sdigs mdzub rnams g.yon du gtad nas/ hūm̐ */ lcags kyus 'khor ba ye shes dbyings su 'dren// gtun shing dgra bgegs gdug pa gnas su sgrol// sdigs mdzub bag chags sku gsung thugs su sbyor// rig pa stobs kyi ye shes dbang bskur ro// oṃ ya mān+ta ka aṃ ku sha mu ṣa la tardza nī tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/
