de nas dmigs pa gong ltar las/ g.yas su lcags kyu dang g.yon du thod khrag gtad la/ hūm̐ */ shes rab yum gyi rang rtags su// 'gugs par byed pa'i lcags kyu dang*// chags thogs med pa'i thod khrag bcas// stong nyid rdo rje'i dbang bskur ro// oṃ be tā lī e ka dzā ti aṃ ku sha ka pā la ru dhī ra tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ yang g.yas su bshan gri dang g.yon du tsit+ta gtad la/ hūm̐ */ thabs mchog sras kyi thugs phyag mtshan// dgra bgegs sgrol byed bshan gri dang*// log lta bsgral ba'i don snying bcas// snying rje chen po'i dbang bskur ro// oṃ ya ma rā tsa khaḍ+ga tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ yang g.yas su ri rab dang g.yon du dgra sta gtad la/ hūm̐ */ ye shes 'gyur med ri rab dang*// nyon mongs rtsad gcod dgra sta 'bar| |'chi bdag thugs kyi mtshon byed rtags// bde ba chen por dbang bskur ro// oṃ ma ra ṇa pa ti su+u parba ta par+shu tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ yang g.yas su be con dang g.yon du zhags pa gtad la/ hūm̐ */ 'khor ba gnas 'joms be con dang*// 'ching bar byed pa'i zhags pa ste// srog bdag thugs kyi rang rtags che// spros bral chen por dbang bskur ro// oṃ prā ṇa pa ti ga dā pā sha tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes bskur zhing dmigs pa gong ltar/ lha rang rang gi thugs ka nas rang rtags kyi phyag mtshan spros pa bu'i snying gar thim par dpon slob gnyis kas bsam/ de ltar 'khor lo'i dbang phyug yab yum sras gsum yang gab sbas pa'i lha gnyis dang bcas pa'i kun rdzob brdar btags pa thugs phyag mtshan rnams kyi dbang bskur bas/ 'khrul pa la a 'thas ther zug rtag bden ngar 'dzin der rtog mtha' gnyis dang bcas pa'i dri ma dag /rdzogs rim ting nge 'dzin bsgom pa la dbang zhing 'gyu dran 'khrul rtog nyin mo'i blos byas thams cad thugs mtha' bral ting nge 'dzin gyi rol pa rang byas su rtogs par byas so// skabs 'dir phyi nang chas dbang rnams zur du yod pa ltar gal che na med mi rung bas sbyar/

zhes go ba bskyed/ gtang rag dbul/ bzhi pa gsang sngags kyi che ba 'dod yon ma spangs lam du slong ba yon tan dngos grub kyi don du maṇ+ḍal phul/ slob mas/ hoḥ chos dbyings ye shes rol pa'i rtsal// gang ltar byas kyang ye shes dang*// 'dod yon ma spangs rgyan gyi mchog /yon tan dngos grub deng stsol cig /gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ sman lag pa g.yas su gtad cing khar sbyin la/ hūm̐ */ lha rnams mchod pa'i dam rdzas rmad byung ba// rtsa brgyad yan lag stong sbyar dngos grub bcud// rigs lnga'i rang bzhin 'chi med a mṛ ta// ye shes lnga rdzogs chen por dbang bskur ro// oṃ ya mān+ta ka pū dza pañtsa a mṛ ta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐// rak+ta g.yon du gtad cing khar byin la/ hūm̐ */ gzung 'dzin chags pas mnar ba'i dgra bgegs rnams| |chags med sa la 'god byed dmar chen po// rgyu gnyis rkyen gsum 'ben chen dam tshig rdzas// dbyings sbyor ye shes chen por dbang bskur ro// oṃ ya mān+ta ka pū dza ma hā rak+ta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐// gtor ma lag gnyis kar gtad la/ hūm̐ */ snod kyi 'jig rten yangs pa'i gtor gzhong du// bcud kyi skye 'gro rnam dag gtor ma'i dngos// 'dzin med ngang nas mchod pa'i dam rdzas mchog /lhun grub kun 'byung chen por dbang bskur ro// oṃ ya mān+ta ka pū dza ba ling+ta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐// zhes bskur/ 'og nas 'byung ba ltar gtor dbang mi byed na gtor ma dngos grub tu rol| gtor dbang byed na skabs 'dir gtor ma la longs mi spyod do// de dag gis ye rdzogs chos nyid mnyam rol yon tan rmad byung sman raka gtor ma'i dbang bskur bas/ dug lnga'i bag chags kyi dbang gis chags sems 'dod sred ser sna'i dri ma dag nas/ gsang sngags thabs kyi che ba 'dod yon thams cad mi spangs lam du 'khyer ba la dbang zhing*/ gzugs/ sgra/ dri/ ro/ reg bya rnams/ snang stong*/

grag stong*/ tshor stong*/ myong stong*/ reg stong ye shes kyi rang rtsal las ma 'das pa'i ngo bos rgyas btab nas ma chags shing ma zhen pa'i sgo nas longs spyod par bya'o// zhes go ba bskyed/ lnga pa gsang sngags stobs kyis che ba phrin las kyi dbang gi don du maṇ+ḍal phul nas/ slob mas/ rang rig ye shes rang rtsal las// rgyal ba'i phrin las du mar snang*// gang 'dul thabs kyi rol pa'i tshogs| |phrin las dbang bskur bstsal du gsol// gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ dbang 'bring po'i tshul ltar na skabs 'dir sbyor ba'i dbang sher dbang ltar bskur la/ dbang gong ma rnams byas na 'dir sbyor dbang mi dgos so// drag po'i sgrol dbang ni/ khams gsum skye 'gro'i srog la dbang bskur ba dang*/ srog ye shes su dbang bskur ba dang*/ mtha' sdud gsum gyi dbang ngo*// dang po ni/ phur bu gtad la/ hūm̐ */ dus gsum rgyal ba ma lus pa'i// phrin las gcig tu bsdus pa rnams// gdul dka' 'dul phyir drag po'i skur// bzhengs pa badz+ra kī la ya// sgril ba tsam gyis lha yang 'dar// bzlas pa tsam gyis srid gsum g.yo// btab na khams gsum rdul du rlog /'debs byed las kyi phur bu 'debs// rigs kyi bu la ngas gtad kyi// zhing bcu tshang ba'i dgra bgegs rnams// sgrol byed pho nyas dbang bskur ro// oṃ ya mān+ta ka badz+ra karma kī la ya a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gtad/ thun rdzas rnams lag tu gtad la/ hūm̐ */ khro rgyal phyag rgya zil gnon gyis// mngags pa'i pho nyar drag gtum can// yungs kar yungs nag ske shangs tshe// gri lcags dur rdo bra ram zangs// sa sna la sogs thun rdzas la// dug sna khrag snas ngar blud cing*// rbad bsad dregs pa'i srog sngags kyis// gzir zhing dregs pa'i skur bsgoms pas// 'dul byed las kyi bshan pa ste// de ltar sde brgyad 'dus pa'i dmag /sngags 'chang bdag gi pho nya'i tshogs// deng 'dir khyod la ngas gtad kyi// bsnyen sgrub drod rtags thob pa dang*// dus la bab tshe las la sbyor// sgrub pa'i drod tshad ma thob cing*// dus min las la sbyor ba ni// dregs pa ma rungs phrag dog nas// rang srog 'chad pa'i nyen mchis kyi// bu yis blo gros ldan par gyis// oṃ ya mān+ta ka trai lokya karma sarba a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐// zhes gtad do/

gnyis pa srog ye shes su dbang bskur ba ni/ liṅga slob ma'i lag tu bzhag /phur pa slob mar gtad la/ hūm̐ */ nyon mongs las kyi sems can rnams// ma rig dbang gis 'khor bar 'khyams// las ngan sdig la longs spyod rnams// las 'phro ngan pa rgyun bcad nas// mya ngan 'das la rab 'god phyir// bsgral ba las kyi gdug pa 'dul// bu yis blo gros 'di gyis la// sdang sems can gyi dgra dang bgegs// rdo rje phur thun sbyor ba yis// rnam shes rten dang phral nas kyang*| |bdag nyid lha yi ting 'dzin gyis// bzas po'i tshe bsod rang la bsdu// de'i rnam par shes pa nyid// ye shes lha yi thugs dang bsre// 'og min gnas su spar byas la// sku gsum thob pa'i sa bon gdab// a dkar 'od kyi 'phro 'du yis// bdag dang lha dang phur bu gsum// nyams pa gso zhing dbang yang bskur// de yi sha khrag rus par bcas// lha tshogs rnams la tshogs su 'bul// tshogs gnyis rdzogs nas byang chub thob// de ltar tshe khrus lung gi ni// gnod byed dgra bgegs bsgral byas nas// sngags pa hom khung nang 'tshang rgya// de ltar mi shes sngags mkhan rnams// srog gcod bshan pa dang mtshungs phyir// ru trar gol zhing dmyal bar ltung*// des na gnad dang ldan gyis la// dgra bgegs gdug pa tshar chod cig /oṃ ya mān+ta ka karma u gra a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes brjod cing slob ma rnams kyis liṅga phur skor bya zhing thun brab bsgral du bcug la/ ling ro gtor mar phul nas sman raka sgron gtor bsngos bsdus pa zhig bya'o// gtang rag 'bul lo// gsum pa mtha' sdud gsum gyi dbang gi don du maṇ+ḍal phul nas/ slob mas/ drag po'i sbyor ba mi bzad pas// dgra bgegs gdug pa tshar bcad nas// mtha' rgyas rim pa rnam gsum gyi// dbang bskur mchog la gnas par mdzod| |ces gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ dang po sreg pa hom gyi dbang ni/

drag po'i sreg thab me 'bar ba lag tu gtad la/ hoḥ lha rnams zhal ni me yin te// sbyin sreg de ni me la gnas// sbyin sreg me ni tshims byas nas// dgyes pas dngos grub ster bar 'gyur// drang srong chen po me lha yis// sngon nas khas blangs mna' bor ba// rnal 'byor phrin las bsgrubs par byas| |de phyir drag po'i mtha' rgyas ni// sreg byed hom la brten par bya// de phyir blo can khyod rnams kyis// drag po'i las sbyor 'di gyis shig /oṃ ya mān+ta ka ag+na ye dz+wa la a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gtad/ gtor zor thogs la/ hūm̐ */ sngon tshe slob dpon man chad nas// da lta sngags 'chang yan chad du// mtha' rgyas drag po zor gyi las// lcags sam bhan+dha'i snod nang du// 'bru sna lnga yi ngar phye las// drag po'i bshos bu zur gsum bzhengs// mda' mdung mtshe yungs rtsang gis brgyan// myos byed dug dang khrag gis byugs// dug gsum 'bar ba'i rlan gyis spras// gshin rje'i dregs pa'i dmag dpung bsdus// bskyed rdzogs bsnyen sgrub gzhu mo la// stong nyid snying rje'i rgyud sbyar nas// stong chen gtor ma'i zor mda' la// gdug byed dmod pa'i mde'u btsugs| |drag sngags 'bar ba'i mtheb sbyor gyis// dgra bgegs bla srog 'ben la rdeg /da lta'i sbyor ba drag po 'di// sngags 'chang rnams kyi mtshon cha ste// bu yis blo gros 'di gyis shig |oṃ ya mān+ta ka karma ba liṃ u gra a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gtad/ gtad mnan gyi yo byad gtad la/ hūm̐ */ drag po las kyi mtha' sdud pa// gdug byed klu dang sa bdag rnams// phrin las bsgrub la mngags pa'i phyir// gnad ldan sa ru mnan byas nas// dgra bgegs 'ching zhing sgrol ba'am// gdug byed klu la gtad nas kyang*// rtsa ba dgu rgyud rlog par byed// snying rje ldan pa'i rnal 'byor gyis// sbyor ba drag pos mtshams sbyar nas// dgra bgegs byang chub sa la 'god// drag po'i phrin las dam pa 'di// skal ldan khyod kyis 'bad de sgrubs// oṃ ya mān+ta ka karma u gra ā krān+ta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/

zhes gtad/ de dag gis gsang sngags mthu stobs kyi yon tan rmad du byung bas drag po sgrol byed sngags pa hom khung du 'tshang rgya ba phrin las kyi dbang bskur ba thob/ nyon mongs pa bag nyal dang bcas pa'i dri ma dag /drag po'i phrin las mtha' dag bsgrub pa la dbang zhing de dag kyang rang phyis tsam du byar mi rung gi/ zhing bcu tshang ba la drod rtags thob pa'i rnal 'byor pas nyams su blang bya'i spyod yul du byos shig /ces go ba bskyed gtang rag 'bul/ gsum pa khyad par gtor ma la brten nas dbang bskur ba ni/ maṇ+ḍal phul nas slob mas/ hoḥ bla ma lhar bcas bdag la dgongs// sgo gsum sgrib pa sbyang ba'i phyir// rdo rje gsum gyi dbang bstsal nas// sku gsum 'grub pa'i dngos grub stsol// ces gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ gtor ma lha gtso 'khor du gsal ba slob ma'i spyi bor bzhag la/ hūm̐ */ dam tshig chen po'i tshul bstan khro bo'i tshogs// 'dir gshegs rtags dang mtshan ma myur ston cig /sku yi dbang mchog mi shigs rdo rje yis// gdos bcas lus kyi sgrib pa sbyang du gsol// oṃ ya mān+ta ka ba ling+ta kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ de bzhin mgrin par gtad/ bdud rtsi sbyin zhing*/ hūm̐ */ dam tshig chen po'i tshul bstan khro bo'i tshogs// 'dir gshegs rtags dang mtshan ma myur ston cig /gsung gi dbang mchog mi shigs rdo rje yis// 'chal ba ngag gi sgrib pa sbyang du gsol// oṃ ya mān+ta ka ba ling+ta wāka.a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ snying khar gtad la| hūm̐ */ dam tshig chen po'i tshul bstan khro bo'i tshogs// 'dir gshegs rtags dang mtshan ma myur ston cig /thugs kyi dbang mchog mi shigs rdo rje yis// 'khrul pa sems kyi sgrib pa sbyang du gsol// oṃ ya mān+ta ka ba ling+ta tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes bskur/ gnas gsum du gtad la/ hūm̐ */ dam tshig chen po'i tshul bstan khro bo'i tshogs// 'dir gshegs rtags dang mtshan ma myur ston cig

|rnam gsum dbang mchog mi shigs rdo rje yis// dug gsum nad gdon sdig sgrib sbyang du gsol// oṃ ya mān+ta ka ba ling+ta sarba sid+dhi pha la a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes bskur/ dbang don gzhan ltar bshad/ dngos grub kyi cho ga byed na sman raka gtor ma tshe gal mthun gsum tshogs rdzas dang bcas pa dbang gi sngon nas nyer bsdogs byas la skabs 'dir dngos grub kyi 'dzab ci 'grub bzlas pa'i rjes su/ hoḥ nam mkha'i khams mnyam zil gnon 'jam pa'i dbyangs// zhes pa nas/ dngos grub dam pa da lta stsol gyi bar gzhi bsnyen zhal gdams kyi dngos grub kyi cho ga ltar brjod la longs spyod/ de ltar slob dpon chen po gtsug lag dpal dges gshin rje'i gshed kyi rgyud thams cad kyi snying po bsdus pa yang zlog me'i spu gri zhes gnubs sangs rgyas ye shes kyi rnam 'phrul gter ston rgya zhang khrom rdo rje 'od 'bar gyis gter nas spyan drangs shing*/ rgyal dbang rin chen phun tshogs tshun rje gong ma na rim phal cher la zhal gzigs shing thugs dam gyi lhag pa'i lha thun mong ma yin pa 'jam dpal tshe bdag phyag rgya zil gnon gyi dbang chen bdud dpung zil gnon yongs su rdzogs pa'i steng du/ dur khrod chas sogs kyi phyi dbang dang nang dbang*/ shin tu gsang ba thun mong ma yin pa'i bka' rdzogs mchod rten gyi dbang*/ thun mong ma yin pa'i gtor dbang bka' gtad bcas legs par thob pa yin pas/ de dag gi skabs nas bshad pa'i dam tshig gi rim pa spyi dang bye brag gshin rje'i gshed kyi rgyud rnams nas gsungs pa'i dam tshig thun mong ma yin pa rnams tshul bzhin du bsrung snyam pa'i sgo nas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ slob mas/ gtso bos ji ltar sogs kyis dam tshig bsrung bar khas blangs shing gtang rag gi maṇ+ḍal rgyas pa 'bul/ gsum pa rjes kyi dkyil 'khor la chu gnyis nyer spyod rol mo sman raka gtor mas mchod cing*/

bstod pa gang rung gis bstod nas gtor ma khang thog tu 'bul/ zor dgra phyogs su 'phang*/ yi ge brgya pas bzod gsol byas nas/ lha'i lha mchog dang*/ bskal pa dpag tu med pa sogs kyi smon lam gdab/ bum mdun gyi lha spyan drangs pa'i ye shes pa rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ rang gis sprul pa'i dam tshig pa oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes rang gi snying gar bsdu/ shis brjod dang bsngo ba smon lam bya zhing las kyi rjes mi mngon par bya'o// spyi don gnyis pa dbang 'bring du byed na/ dkyil 'khor gyi 'jug pa rnams tshar rjes dbang thob 'dod tsam las bsnyen sgrub mi byed pa la bum gsang sher tshig rnams bskur nas lha dbang man chad dor/ yang bsnyen sgrub tsam byed pa ma gtogs/ gzhan don mi nus pa la dkyil 'khor gyi 'jug pa rnams tshar rjes sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las lnga po bskur gzhan rnams dor/ spyi don gsum pa bsdus pa'i lugs ni/ nad pa sogs la gsol gdab rgyun bshags kyi mjug tu slob ma lhar gsal/ byin 'bebs bya/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra dang rgya gram gyis brtan par byas rjes mjug gi gtor ma bzhi po bskur ba kho nas 'thus so// dbang rgyas pa'i lugs 'di lha 'di nyid la mchog tu 'dzin cing bsnyen sgrub las sbyor la dam bca' 'dzin pa/ rang gi chos dang srid kyi rgyud 'dzin las gzhan du spel na dam tshig nyams par 'gyur ro// bsdus pa'i lugs la gtor ma kho nas bskur ram/ yang na dang por bum pa spyi bor bzhag bum chu blud/ gnyis par thod pa mgrin par bzhag bdud rtsi sbyin/ gsum par me long snying gar gtad/ bzhi par gtor ma gnas gsum du bskur/ de ltar byed na bum pa gnyis gtso las su byed/ thod chang dang me long gtor ma rnams lhar bskyed la thod chang dang me long gi lha bzhu nas dbang bskur| gtor ma'i stod lha dang smad 'dod yon du bsams la bskur/ bum pa gnyis ni dbang chen gi skabs ltar sgrub dgos/

de ltar yang zlog me'i spu gri'i dbang gi cho ga bdud dpung zil gnon zhes bya ba 'di'ang lcags sdig gi dbang chog mu tig phreng ba lha grangs ha cang mang ba dang*/ rjes gnang rnon po nang gcod kyang bsdus shing sngags dbang tsam las med cing 'di nyid dang 'brel chags par mi 'dug pas zla gsang gi rgyud rnams gtso bor byas/ rdo rje theg pa'i dbang bskur gzhan nas kyang rung mthun gyis kha bskangs nas| 'bri gung pa gshin rje'i gshed kyi rnal 'byor pa chos kyi grags pas/ lcags lug zla ba dang po'i rgyal bas cho 'phrul chen po bstan pa'i dus dge bar chos grwa chen po bkra shis tshugs su sbyar ba ste/ 'di'i dkyil 'khor sogs gnad kha yar slob dpon dgyes pa'i gsung gi gsang ba las rtogs par byos shig/ //sarba maṅga laṃ//
